80: Kegavvna dilela la kayyma hahu madora sheviaa ella lenishmathon detzaddikayyay. hachi name hay madora sheviaa letatta la kayyma ella legufehon detzaddikayyay. lemeheve kolla chad da kegavvna deda. (bazzohar gadol defus manetavebah kareymevaneh lavebaleyn matchil kan vayyomer elokim kulei ameraz rabbi yitzchak shehu bazzohar katan lekamman baddaf ma amud bet)

Ta chaze, amar rabbi shimon shiva madorin innun dekaamaran. uvego innun it 7 hechalin meinnun raze mehemnuta lokovel 7 rekiin illain. uvechol hechala vehechala it ruchin illain. hekkala kadmaa hacha it rucha deitmana al nishmathon degerin deitgayyru. verochomoyl shemeh. veihu natil lon veithannun mizziv yekara dilela.
Hekkala tinyayna it rucha chada aheyneal shemeh. veda kayyma al kol innun nishmatin deravye dela zechu behay alma lemile beorayyta. veihu kayyma alayyhu veolif lon.

Hekkala telitaa behay it rucha chada aderaheyneal shemeh. veihu kayyma al nishmathon deinnun deahadderu bityuveta vela ahadderu. kegon dechashivu vead la ahadderu behu mitu. illen tardin lon baggehinnam. ulevatar alin lon lehay rucha memanna venatil lon. vechamdan leithannaa mizziv yekara demarehon vela ithannun. veillen ikrun bene vasar. vealayyhu ketiv, (Yeshayahu 66:23) vehaya midde chodesh bechadsho umidde shabbat beshabbatto yavo chol basar lehishtachavot lefanay amar Adonai:

Hekkala reviaa hacha kayyma chad rucha gaderayhaal (nusach acher gahedaheal) shemeh. da kayyma al kol innun nishmatin dekatole dishar ammin (ovde kochavim umazzalot) leoola lon go purefira demalka. veitreshimu tamman ad yoma deyinkom lon kudesha berich hu dichtiv, (Tehillim 110:6) yadin baggoyim male geviyyot machatz rosh al eretz rabba:

Hekkala chamishaa hacha kayyma chad rucha deikre adeyreyal veda kayyma al kol illen nishmatin (chaser) (hechala shetitaa tzdkyl hechala sheviaa 101) (nusach acher dachesayday) (daachidan betiyyuveta) deitkayymu behahu sitra. veillen innun leela mikkulhu di bemadora da illaa al kolla umikkael (shemeh) rav memanna (alayyhu) al kulhu kayyma (dekayymin) beh. vechamma elef verivvan kulhu kayymin techoteh behahu sitra. vetamman mitaddenin innun nishmatin dachaside behahu nehora illaa denagda mealma deate.

Ta chaze (chaser kan hechal 6 7): amar rabbi shimon man hu deyada lesadra tzelota (kammeh) demareh kemoshe. beshaata deitzterich leh lesaddera tzeloteh bearichut sadar. uveshaata deitzterich leh lekatzra hachi name. amar rabbi shimon ha ashkachna besifre kadmae siddura deraze derazin bekishshura chada. zimnin deitzterich lesaddera tzeloteh kedka yaut. ulekashra kishrin livsume lemareh kedka yeut. uleminda leyachada yichuda shelemata lemikra rekiin uleaftacha tarin ufitchin dela yehe man deyimche bideh.

Zakkain innun tzaddikayya deinnun yade lemifte lemarehon ulevittule gezirin uleashraa shechinta bealma ulenachata birchan ulemeede marehon dedinin dela yishletun bealma. kam rabbi shimon veamar (Tehillim 106:2) mi yemallel gevurot Adonai vegomer. man yegalle afra meenach avraham chasida yamina dekudesha berich hu. degale lach raza derazin. veshariat tzelotin bealma. veitgalyayn lach hechale demalka illaa.
Shiva hechalin kaddishin innun. veinnun kayyaymin betarin bekiyyuma. uvechol chad vechad al
81: Tzelota deyichuda (davar acher 33 demareh) deman deyada livsume lemareh uleyachada yichuda bishlimu. deyada leoola bechulhu ulekashra kishrin illen beillen rucha berucha. rucha tattaa berucha illaa ketiv, (Yeshayahu 26:16) Adonai batzar pekaducha tzakun lachash musarcha lamo: (ayyen vefardes beshaar hechalot hakkedoshot vaheykelavetahetamevarevat).

Hechala kadmaa ketiv, (Shemot 24:10) vetachat raglav kemaase livnat hassappir ucheetzem hashshamayim latohar. raza derazin (davar acher it) ruach deikre sappira. kesappiru deeven tava natzitz litren sitrin. nehora chad salik venachit. vehahu nehora chivvavr natzitz lechol setar ela vetatta ulearba sitre alma. nehoreh talyayn satim vegalyay.

Minhora da mitparshin 4 nehorin led sitrin. vechulhu nehorin chad nehora. kevutzina desharga dedalik venatzitz nehorin lechezu deayynin divne nesha. veinnun nehorin dishragga salkin venachatin azlin vetayyvin miggo hahu esha dinhora desharga dedalik vechulhu chad nehora. hachi name illen. unetzitzin kulhu nehorin kechezu dinchasha betisha besumeka kema deittemar (Yechezkel 1:7) venotztzim keen nechoshet kalal. da hu leyamina.

Lismala it rucha deikre levana. veda itkelil berucha kadmaa veal da beda. nehoreh sumak vechivvavr kechada. begin denafka meinnun nehorin kadmain. kad atu nehorin deda matu binhorin kadmain veitkelilu beh veinnun chad. veitchazzun nehore kadmae bilchodayyhu. vela itgalyayn innun ochoranin vela ityedau dealu begavavyyhu veittammeru beh. kema deat amer (Bereshit 41:21) velo noda ki bau el kirbenna vegomer. veda hu rucha berucha deinnun chad. nehorin binhorin deinnun chad. vehacha innun teren tarin (rekiin) tattain meinnun rekiin deikrun (sefer acher shamayim) sheme hashshamayim (rakia).

Mitteren ruchin illen menatztzetzan itberiu innun ofannin deinnun kaddishin. dedinayyhu kedina dechayyot kedichtiv, (Yechezkel 1:16) mare haofannim umaasehem vegomer. veda hu dichtiv udemut hachayyot marehen kegachale esh boarot kemare hallappidim hi mithallechet ben hachayyot. man hi, da rucha kaddisha atar denafku minneh veihi nahir lon. dichtiv venoga laesh umin haesh yotze barak.

Kad itkelil rucha berucha nafik minnayyhu nehiru dechad chevavta remiz (nusach acher ramya) al 4 ofannin. veha diukena dileh kearye shallit al elef utelat mea ribbo deofannin ochoranin. gadfaha denishra hay itmanna al (kol) innun ofannim. bed galgallim natlin kol chad vechad meinnun arba. bechol galgalla vegalgalla telat samchin. veinnun teresar samchin bed galgallin. rucha da shalata al kolla. mehacha nafku. veda rucha kayyayma lechulhu. (davar acher veha) minah itzanu.

Illen 4 (davar acher 33 ofannim) 4 anpin lechol chad vechad. vechol innun anpin istachyayn learba sitrin dehahu chevata dekayyma alayyhu. kad natlin illen arba techot hahu chevata. alu da beda umeshallevan da beda kema deat amer, (Shemot 27 velo) makbilot hallulaot ishsha el achotah. leitkelala chada bechada uleoola da beda. kad natlin innun galgallin ishtema kal neimuta bechol innun chelin diltatta lezinayyhu.

Techot hechala da mitparsin chelin levar lechamma sitrin dirkiin diltatta ad dematu lekochva deshabbetay. kulhu istachyayn lehechala da. mittamman itzanu. kol illen di behechala da kulhu istechu lehahu rucha dichtiv, (Yechezkel 1:12) el asher yihye shamma haruach lalechet yelechu lo yissabbu belechtan. veda hu hechala deikre livnat hassappir.

Rucha da dechalil rucha ochora tinyayna salka venachata nehoreh dela shachich (shavak) lealmin kenura deshimsha go maya. let man dekaim aleh. bar reuteh devar nash zakkaa, behahu tzelota dealat behahu hechala vesalka lekashra kishrin bishlimu besheruta
82: Deruach (nusach acher dinhora) da kedka chaze. keden nehora itattaf beh vechade bah vesalka imah leitkashshera bekishshura dehechala tinyayna. leitkelala rucha dechalil berucha ochora illaa dealeh.

Verucha da dechalil kalil beh hahi chevavta vechol innun ofannin vegalgallin veitachadan beh kegavvna deitachada esha bemaya, umaya beesha. darom betzafon, tzafon bedarom. mizrach bemaarav, umaarav bemizrach. hachi itachadan kulhu da beda veitkashsheran da beda. hahu rucha salka leitkashshera. vehahi chevata istachyay leela legabbe hechala tinyayna veistachyayn da beda.

Beemtzaita dehechala da naitz chad ammuda desalka ad emtzaita dehechala ochora. veihu nakiv venaitz (nusach acher nativ naitz) mittatta leela leitdabbeka rucha berucha vechen ad leela mikkulhu. lemeheve kulhu rucha chada kema deat amer, (Kohelet 3:19) veruach echad lakkol:

Hechala tinyayna ketiv, (Shemot 24:10) ucheetzem hashshamayim latohar. hacha ihu hahu rucha deikre zohar. vekayyma bechivvavrta tadir. dela itarvu gevavnav beochora. veihu etzem dela ishtanne lealmin. da lav ihu beitgalya hachi leitnatztzetza keochora. da kashe leitgalleyay. kistimu deena dechad mitgalgela izdehar venatzitz begilgula. veda uf hachi. begin dechad hahu rucha kadmaa salka megalgel begilgula vegale leh, veitkkashshar bahadeh bekishshura dechivvavrta deena go gavavn ochora deihu dakkik minneh deshare aloy.

Mitgalgela rucha da miggo rucha diltatta. nehora diltatta aschar legalgela (nusach acher vegalgal) nehora da veitnehir. vela yachil leitnahara ad deachid tattaa beh veitkashshar bahadeh ucheden anhir. veachid binhora diltatta (davar acher 33 dehava nahir) dehu kalil vela ishtanne kelal. ella itgalya begineh begilgula dileh.

Vechad nehora da mitgalgela natil nehora ochora listar semala veitgalgela bahadeh veistachar immeh. veraza da ketiv, (Shir HaShirim 7:2) chammuke yerechayich kemo chalaim maase yede amman. zakkaa ihu man deyada legallaa (nusach acher legilgala) nehorin.

Rucha ochora itkelil bahadeh veistachar (veanhir) venahir sacharaneh begavavn tichla vechivvavr. hahu chivvavr itkashshar bechivvavr da. vehahu tichla itkashshar besumeka dinhora tattaa delistar semala. veitkelilu da beda vehavu chad. veikrun etzem hashshamayim. vechol ma diltatta vehahu hechala diltatta kolla itkelil hacha. uvegin decholla itkelil hacha itkere etzem hashshamayim.

Mikkelala dinhorin illen itberiu innun serafim deshit gadfin kema deat amer (Yeshayahu 6:2) serafim omdim mimmaal lo shesh kenafayim shesh kenafayim laechad. kulhu beshesh. begin dechulhu meetzem hashshamayim. illen innun deokidu leinnun dela chayyshe al yekara demarehon. veraza deishtammesh betagga chalaf. man dekare vetane shit sidre mishna da hu man deyada lesaddera ulekashshera kishshura yichuda demareh kedka yaot. illen innun dimkaddeshin shema kaddisha demarehon bechol yoma tadir.

Kad mitgalgelan nehorin nafak minnayyhu nehiru dechad chevavta. deihi kayyayma veramya al 4 chevavn shallitin al kammay dichlilu lon begavavyyhu. uveillen kad natlin itchafyayn serafim tattae nechashim denafke miggo hahu nachash saraf degarim mota lechol alma.

Illen chevavn anpe nesher mistakkelan legabbe hahu chevata nishra illaa dealayyhu, kema deat amer, (Mishlei 30:19) derech hannesher bashamayim. rucha da shalta al kolla. hahi chevavta deramiz (nusach acher deramya) al kulhu istakkeyay leela vechulhu legabbeh (davar acher legabbah).

Kulhu kad natlin mizdazein kamma chayyaylin. minhon nehirin. minhon mittabbere (nusach acher masetakeray makemayhaven) mikkiyyumehon (memehon) veokidun lon benura veatyayn umitchaddeshan kemilkaddemin. kulhu alin techot hahu chevata mistatterin techot gadfaha leachlala lon leela.
83: Salkin kad rucha izdehar bego hahu chevavta. arba galgallin lechol chad vechad. galgalla chada isteche listar mizrach. telat samchin natlin leh veistachyayn leemtzaita. vegalgalla chada isteche listar maarav, utelat samchin natlin leh veistachyayn leemtzaita. vegalgalla chada isteche listar darom. utelat samchin natlin leh veistachyayn leemtzaita. vegalgalla ochora isteche listar tzafon utelat samchin natlin leh veistachyayn leemtzaita. vechulhu samchin teresar natlin miggo emtzaita. vehahu emtzaita sagir ufetach. vechol galgalla vegalgalla kad natla kala ishtema bechulhu rekiin.

Illen arba chevavn (davar acher dilella) kulhu (mitlabbeshan) (sefer acher ashetaleban) da beda. vealin innun ofannim diltatta bego illen chevavn dilela kelilan illen beillen, rucha da deitkelil beinnun ruchin melahata vesalka leitachada leela vekayyma leitachada uleitkashshera biruta devar nash zakkaa behahi tzelota detzalle. dechad salka vealat behahu hechala natil kolla vechulhu natlin bahadah veitkelilu da beda ad deitkelilu behahu rucha. vehahu rucha natla biruta dekishshura deyichuda ditzlota dimyachada kolla ad dematu kulhu lehechala telitaa kelilan da beda kedkadmay, esha bemaya, umaya beesha. rucha beafra, veafra berucha. mizrach bemaarav, maarav bemizrach. tzafon bedarom, darom betzafon. vehachi hane kulhu mitkashsheran da beda umitachadan da beda umeshallevan da im da. vechen kamma chayyaylin umashshiryayn deitachadu (nusach acher denachate) letatta veitarvu beinnun tattae ad dematu lechochava detzedek vetamman kamma memannan al alma.

Vechad rucha da deitkelil (davar acher itkelil) mikkulhu vechulhu kelilan beh. salik veitachad veal bego hechala telitaa ad deitachad berucha detamman bego hahu ammuda dekaim beemtzaita. ucheden kolla ishtelim ad hacha kedka yaot. vechulhu rucha chada kalil mikkolla ushelim mikkolla kema deat amer veruach echad lehena. hacha hakkeraa leitdabbeka bemareh:

Hechala telitaa. hechala da ihu hechala dehahu rucha deikre noga, rucha da ihu dachyay barir mikkulhu. let leh gavvavn deitchazze beh lav chivvavr velav yarok velav ucham vela sumak. uvegin kach ikre tohar. dachyay berira mikkol illen tattain. veaf al gav deihu dachyay mikkolla, la itchazze ad deillen tattae mitgalgelan veachidan (nusach acher vakeraan) beh vealin begavvih (nusach acher beh). kevan dealin begavveh keden achaze nehoreh vela gavavn chad mikkulhu.

Kad ishtelim hay rucha mikkulhu tattae, appik minneh nehora dechalil bitlat nehorin. innun teren nehorin salkin venachatin venatztzin. behahu nitztzotza itchazzun esrin uteren nehorin meshanyayn da min da vechulhu chad nehora. vealin bego hahu chad nehora. vehahu nehora kalil lon.

Vela nahir, bar bezimna deillen nehorin diltatta salkin vehahu reuta ditzlota natil lechulhu. keden hahu nehora nafik miggo hahu rucha. itnehir hahu nehora veappik illen teren nehorin natztzin veitchazzun kechusheban 22 atvavn deorayyta. levatar mithadderin uchelilan behahu nehora.

Kol innun nehorin tattae (beinnun nehorin) kulhon kelilan behani nehorin (tattain) vechulhu binhora da. hay nehora ihu kalil bego hahu rucha. vehahu rucha kayyma behechala telitaa da. vela kaim leityashva ella bego hechala reviaa detiuveteh lesalka legavveh.

Illen nehorin denafku migo hahu rucha kad menatztzin mitchabberan kulhu nehorin denatztzan. beshaata denafke miggo hahu nehora chada vedachakin (nusach acher vedachyayn) leitnatztzetza. nafke minnayyhu chad chevata kaddisha ravreva deyoknaha kechezu dechol innun
84: Shear chevata diukena dearye vediukena densher kelilan kechada veitavidu bah chad diukena minnayyhu.

Techot hay chevata it 4 ofannin illain (chezu dilhon) kechezu detarshish merakman bichlilu dechol gevavnin. veshit mea elef ribbo (ravrevan) kulhu begavavyhu. veillen 4 ofannim bitmanya gadfin kulhu. vechulhu nafkin miggo nehiru dehahu chevata deshalta alayyhu. beshaata denatzitz hahu nehora mafka chayaylin chayaylin illen.

Veillen 4 ditchotah kayyaymin bed sitrin dealma bed anpin kol chad vechad. teren anpin mistakkelan legabbe hahu chevata. uteren anpin mechafyayn begadfayyhu meinnun nehorin denatztzan dela yachlin leistakkala.

Bechol zimna denatle illen bed galgallin (davar acher uterisar) (uteren) samchin kekadmae itavid mehahu zea dilhon kamma chayaylin umashshiryayn dechulhu meshabbechin umezammere dela mishtakkeche lealmin. uleillen let lon shiura.

Arba pitchin it lehechala da learba sitrin dealma. eser memannan bechol pitcha ufitcha. uvezimna dechulhu di bego hechalin diltatta. veinnun hechalin salkin biru ditzlota dachyay. kulhu patchin pitchin. ad dichlilan kulhu illen beillen. umeshallevin illen beillen. vealin kulhu memannan go memannan. mashshiryayn go mashshiryayn. ofannim bechayyot vechayyot beofannim. beillen ofannim, nehorin binhorin rucha berucha. ad dealu berucha da.

Behechala da it ducheta chada kechezu dedahava denatzitz. vetamman genizin kamma chayyaylin umashshiryayn dela salkin vela mitatterin leela ela beshaata dechol illen kashrin keshiran vehechol natil leitattera kulhon nafkin malyayn bedina. veikrun mare teresin. shelichan bealma miggo mare dinin di behechala reviaa. behay ducheta talyayn bearba sitrin shit mea elef rivvavn meginim dedahava lechol setar usetar. vechen letatta minnayyhu shurin makkefan veinnun shittin.

Vechol hane meginim kulhu maggichin keravin seyayfin veromchin levar bechol innun sheliche dinin dealma ad dematu dargin bedargin lechochava demadim. ucheden hechala salka veitatterat behahu rucha bechol innun chayaylin veishtaar hahu ducheta beatreh. vehahu ducheta ikre ta haratzim. innun shelichin merahate leashlama dinin ufuranin bechol sitre alma.

Kad salka tzelota natil kol hane nehorin umashshiryayn vekashar kesharin veitkelilu kulhu kechada. ad deitkeshar rucha berucha veinnun chad. vealu go hahu ammuda leitkelala berucha dehechala reviaa. zakkaa chulakeh man deyada raza demareh vearim digleh beatar deitzterich.

Veta chaze kolla itzterich da leda veda leda leashlama da im da uleitnehara da beda ad desalik kolla leatar deitzterich shelimu. mittatta bekadmita umilleela levatar. ucheden ihu shelimu bechol sitrin veishtelim kolla kedka yaut.

Man deyada razin illen veavid shelimu. da ihu mitdebak bemareh uvattil kol gezerin kashin. veihu aatar lemareh umashich birchan al alma. veda ihu bar nash deikre tzaddika ammuda dealma utzeloteh la ahadar rekanyay vechulakeh bealma deate, veihu bechusheban beni mehemnuta.

Ta chaze kol hane hechalin vechol hane chevata vechol hane chayalin vechol hanne nehorin vechol hane ruchin kulhu itzterichu da leda. begin leishtallama mittatta. uleishtallama levatar milleela. illen hechalin innun mitdabbekin da beda.

Vechulhu kegonin dilleela (nusach acher deena) mitdabbekin da im da. kol ma di begavavyyhu innun kehahu chezu demitchazzeya (97 1, 62) bistimu kad mitgalgela ena veitchazze hahu zahara natzitz. vehahu ma dela itchazze (beh) behahu gilgula. ihu hahu rucha deshalta al kolla. uvegin kach kayyma da veda dargin al dargin (vedargin al dargin) ad deitattar kolla
85: Veta chaze ilmale kol innun gevavnin deena deitchazyayn, kad astim ena veitgalgela begalgalla la itchazzun innun gevavnin dezaharan. veilmale innun gevavnin, la itdabbak hahu desatim deshalta alayyhu. ishtechach decholla talyay da beda veitkashshar da beda
Kad itkelil kolla kechada behechala telitaa. ureuta ditzlota salka leitattera behechala reviaa. keden kolla chad. ureuta chada vekishshura chada. hacha hishtachavaa leitratztzaa bemareh:

Hechala reviaa, hechala da ihu meshanya mikkulhu. arba hechalin leda. da lego min da vechulhu chad hechala. hacha ihu rucha deikre zekut, beatar da mithappech zechut dechol bene alma. rucha da natil kolla.

Minneh nafku shivin nehorin kulhu menatztzan. vechulhu beiggula dela mitpashte keillen ochoranin. mitdabbekin da beda unehirin da beda achidan da beda. kol zachyayn dealma kamme illen nehorin kayyaymin. mikkulhu nafke teren nehorin shekulin kechada dekayyme kammayyhu tedira.

Lokovel illen innun shivin ravrevan memannan levar desacharin kol (hane) (davar acher innun) arba hechalin. shivin nehorin illen utere nehorin dekayymin kamayyhu kulhu penimain go lego. veraza da dichtiv, (Shir HaShirim 7:3) bitnich aremat chittim suga bashshoshannim.

Lekamme nehorin illen alin kol zechu. vechol ovadin dealma leitdena. teren nehorin illen innun sahade sahaduta. begin (deinnun) deit shiva ene Adonai dimshattete bechol ara (sefer acher ken kol) kol ma deitavid bealma itreshim behahu ovada mammash vehahu zechuta mammash vekayyme bekiyyumayyhu. veillen teren nehorin chaman behu umistakkelan vesahade kamme illen 70 nehorin. illen 70 gizre gizrin vedayyne dinin hen letav hen levish. vehacha ihu atar dizchuta.

Rucha da beh itreshimu atvavn telat deinnun (159 amud alef) Yahu, dechad illen atvavn mitdabbekan behay atar beitdabbekuta didchura venukeva keden itreshimu beh vela itadun mittamman. levatar nafak chad nehora nahir learba sitrin. hay nehora appik telat ochoranin deinnun telat batte dina dedayynin dinin ochoranin bemillin dealma beutera bemiskenu bemarin bishlimu bechol innun shear millin dealma itdan behu. chad hechala leinnun 70 kadmae lego. telata leillen telata ochoranin.

Salka hay rucha vechalil kol innun diltatta. veappik chad chevavta kaddisha mitlahata veayylin lah keeni enasha leashgacha beelef alfin veribbo rivvavn chayaylin marehon dedina. kulhu natlin pitkin ufatchin vesagrin bealma veashlimu dina.

Techot hay chevata 4 serafim melahatan kulhu kechezur veshoshan ushevive deesha. salkin amud bet galgallin lechol chad melahatan beesha. kad natlin itavid nahar chad di nura. elef alfin meshamshin lehahu nura, mittamman nafke kamma chayyaylin. kad galgallin natlin. kamma innun ribbo rivvavn diykumun minnayyhu bego hahu nura. techot hechala tinyayna nafke chayyaylin dimzammerin veatyayn lekarva hacha veittokdun kulhu.

Kol innun (69 1) memannan dealma deitmannun leshaltaa mehacha nafik dinhon leshaltaa miggo hahu rucha deitreshim bitlat atvavn. umehacha maberin kiyyumayyhu mealma veitdenu behay nura denagid venafik. della itmasar behay hechala. begin deitreshimu bitlat (davar acher telat) atvavn hacha hay rucha itkelil behu. hahi chevavta appik chayyaylin umashshiryayn delet lehon chushebna.

Kol dinin dealma mehay hechala nafke hen letav hen levish. bar (181 amud alef) telat bane chayye umezone. dela ityeyhav reshu beatar da. deha behahu nahar illaa dechol nehorin nagdin minneh kayyma milla. beemtzaita
86: Dehechala da hu atar metakkena lokovel rucha dilela bego rucha da veda salka behu.

Teren eser patchin innun lehechala da. bechol pitcha ufitcha kol innun sarchin umemannan deinnun machreze leodaa letatta kol innun dinin dizminin lenachata letatta. kema deat amer, (Daniel 4:11) kare vechayil vechen amar godu ilana vegomer.

Umiggo karoze illen natle milla kol marehon degaddefin ad deode milla larakia (125 1) dechamma. umittamman kad nafik shimsha nafik milla veitshatyay bealma ad demate lehahu chivya dirkia (125 1) dechol kochve dirkia gelidu beh deihu beemtzaita dirkia.

Veshamin milla venaktin lah innun sarchin ditchot (shemayya) (davar acher shimsha) veinnun dimmannan al hahu chivya umittamman itpashshat lealma. veafillu ruchin veshedin veafillu ofe shemaya modae leh bealma. karozin tavin vesatmin pitchin. la salka (leistalleka) rucha berucha ad dechulhu ruchin tattae kulhu chad bahade (rucha batar) hay rucha vechulhu itkelilan vealin da beda ad deitavid kolla chad.

Bar nash kad ihu beve mareh hacha itdan hen lechayyim hen lammavet. chayyin talyay leela i itdan hacha lechayyim yahave chayyin milleela vei la, la yahavin. zakkaa chulakeh man deitdevak bemareh veyeul venafik. hacha kida beanpin beara leitgabbara al dina. al hay hechala ittemar (Devarim lak) el emuna veen avel vegomer:

Hekkala chamishaa. hechala da hechala divraka zeher. deihu rucha demazhir nahir leinnun tatae. rucha da ihu kalil ufatach vesagir nahir venatzitz lekol sitrin. minnetzitzo da nahir chad nehora keen argevavna. nehora da kalil kol (davar acher kelal) gevavnin denaharin. nehora chivvavr veucham sumak veyarok. itkelilan illen beillen. itrekim chivvavr besumak. ucham beyarok. levatar chivvavr beucham veitavid chad chevavta merukkama veitkelil bah yarok vesumak. deyoknaha kidiukena devar nash dechalil kol diukenin.

Minah nafku 4 samchin deinnun chevavn ravrevan al illen diltatta. chad ikre ofan deihu teren. begin dechad itchazze hay itnehir ochora begavevy. davik da beda. al da beda. levatar al ochora da beda veitchazzun 4 reshin led sitrin dealma vechulhu chad gufa. veillen innun dichtiv behu (Yechezkel 1:16) kaasher yihye haofan betoch haofan, vechulhu illen keshirin da beda. kechezu (nusach acher dacheyzevan) dechevavn illain dela mitparshan lealmin. hay chevata dearba gevavnin merukkaman achidan illen beillen led sitrin. mehacha kad natla chevata da natla litren sitrin.
Hay rucha divraka itkelil bitren ruchin. rucha da divraka appik chad chevata vechol innun nehorin. rucha ochora itnehir minneh deikre rucha melahata

Naharin minneh teren nehorin deinnun arba. veillen nehorin mithappechin bigvavnin. vehacha ihu (Bereshit 3:24) lahat hacherev hammithappechet. illen innun nehorin demithappechan shenana decharba (veillen galif) veilen kayyme al hechala diltatta. begin dehay lahat hacherev kayyma al innun 70 nehorin deve dina. mehacha kol innun dayaynin dedayyne dina charba talyay al reshayyhu milleela.

Hay lahat hacherev deillen innun nehorin delistar semala appiku chad chevata ochora dekayyma al 4 dela kayme bekiyyumayyhu tere mimina utere missemala. kad rucha dechevata hay al beillen. natzitz minayyhu tere nitzotzin melahatan. venafke mehay hechala levar umithappeche tadir. illen nitzotzin (53 2) melahatan lezimnin nukeve lezimnin guvere lezimnin ruchin lezimnin irin kaddishin.

May tama begin dechad itkelil hay chevavta bechevavta kadmaa, miggo tekifu deitkelilan da beda, nafka chad nitztzotza melahata tadir dela itdeach lealmin, veshata veazla abbatrayyhu deinun teren nitzotzin.
Vehasheta inun guverin veavdin shelichuta bealma, vead la mesayyme mitdaache (keden) vehahu nitzotza batash behu
87: Venahir lon veitchaddeshun kemillekadmin veinun nukeve veazle veshatan vead la mesayyme mitdaache. vehay nitzotza batash behu venahir lon veithadderan kemillekaddemin, begin dehahu nitzotza kalil mikkolla kalil mid gevavnin uvegin da inun mithappechin lechol hane gavvne.

Rucha da itkelil berucha ochora kidkaamaran veitchazzun teren kechada, vela keochoranin kadmain dechad itkelil da beda la itchazze bar chad. vehacha itchazzun teren vekayme bachavivuta kelilan mikkulhu tattae, veaf al gav deinnun teren innun chad. kad itpeshat (nusach acher bar daatapeshatev) rucha berucha veitchazzun bechavivuta kelilan mikkulhu tattae, veda (davar acher da) hu raza dichtiv, (Shir HaShirim 4:Adonai) shene shadayich kishne afarim teome tzeviya haroim bashshoshannim.

Vechad teren ruchin mitpashtan da beda bechavivuta keden ithaddar hay hechala veikre hechal ahava hechala dirchimuta, hechala da kaim tadir bekiyyumeh, itgeniz beraza derazin leman deitzterich leitdabbeka beh. vehacha ketiv, (Shir HaShirim 7:13) etten et doday lach.

Levatar kad naharin teren ruchin deinnun chad nafke kamma chayyaylin lechamma sitrin alfin verivvavn delet lon shiura, minhon ikrun dudaim. minhon gefanim. minhon rimmonim. ad dematu kamma chayaylin levar ad hahu kochava deikre noga vechulhu bachavivu dela mitparshin lealmin, behacha ketiv, (Shir HaShirim 8:7) im yitten ish et kol hon beto baahava boz yavuzu lo. hacha (davar acher ketiv) hishtachavaa uferisu deyadin leitdabbeka birchimu demareh:

Hechala shetitaa hacha hu rucha deikre chut hashshani, raza dichtiv, (Shir HaShirim 4:3) kechut hashshani siftotayich, hay hechala (hechala deikre) ikre hekkal haratzon, hacha rucha deihu raava dechol hane ruchin tattain rahatin avatreh leitdabbeka beh binshika birchimuta.

Hay rucha itkelil beshit. vekayyma beshit. itkelil beshit diltatta bahadeh. vekayyma beshit illain. uvegin chach hay rucha appik teresar nehorin kelilan kulhu mittatta umilleela, hane teresar nehorin innun chadun lesalka leela ulekabbela kol innun diltatta.

Hechala da deihu ratzon raava decholla, man dekashar kishrin, vesalik lon hacha, da hu deappik ratzon meAdonai bachavivuta. bego hechala da itkenish moshe birchimu denashik neshike rechimuta. hay hu hechala demoshe. rucha da rucha dirchimuta, rucha deyichuda deamshich rechimu lechol sitrin.

Veinnun (davar acher innun) teresar nehorin salkin velahatin. minnetzitzu dilhon nafke arba chevavn kaddishin rechime deahava, illen ikrun chayyot gedolot leitchabbera innun zute leitkelala behu, dichtiv, (Tehillim 104:25) chayyot ketannot im gedolot.

Illen achidan da beda led sitrin, keegoza demitchabbera led sitrin, ubbegin kach ikre hechala da, ginnat egoz dichtiv, (Shir HaShirim 6:11) el ginnat egoz yaradti, may el ginnat egoz, begineh deginnat egoz yaradti deihu hechala dirchimu leitdabbeka dechura benukeva.

Illen arba mitparshan litresar, telat telat lechol setar. kol innun tattae kelilan behu. uvehu kayaymin ruchin beruchin nehorin binhorin, kulhu illen beillen ad deitavidu chad. ucheden hay rucha dechalil mikkulhu salka leitattera (nusach acher leitteara) berucha dilela hahu deikre shamayim vezammin leh leitchabbera bahadeh, kevan deitkesharu kulhu diltatta bahadeh amar (Shir HaShirim 1:2) yishshakeni minneshikot pihu, ucheden ihu chedva leitkashshera rucha berucha uleishtallama da beda, keden ihu shelimu bechibbura chada.
Kevan dehay rucha itchabbar bahadeh veishtelim da beda veitnehiru da beda bechol shelimu kedka chaze behay reuta detzalle bar nash zakkaa desalik kola kedka chaze,
88: Ad hahu atar lechabbera rechimu da beda, keden (davar acher shemayya itchabbar berucha da birchimu bishlimu baanaheravetaa mitdabbekan da beda, keden) kol innun hechalin vechol innun ruchin deitkelilu behay kol chad vechad meinnun ruchin vehechalin deinnun bichlala deshamayim kol chad vechad natil hahu hechala vehahu rucha (baatar) deitchazze leh leitchabbera bahadeh uleishtallama bahadeh kedka yaut.

(Davar acher begin dehahu rucha shetitaa deikre shemayya rucha kaddisha leella natil hechala da rucha da deikre 346 salik lon legabbayyhu behahu yichuda. vehachi atechaberan ratzon laataneshakea) (ken 120 507) (nusach acher begin dehahu rucha shetitaa deikre ratzon salik lon legabbayyhu behahu yichuda vehachi atechaberan shamayim deihi rucha kaddisha leella natil hechala da rucha da deikre ratzon laataneshakea) da beda. leitchabbera da beda leishtallama da beda. veraza da (Bereshit 29:11) vayyishshak yaakov lerachel vegomer.

Avraham deihu yemina leela natil (davar acher 33 hechala dekaamaran) (hechal ahava) rucha deikre ahava leitkashshera da beda leitchabbera da beda lemehve chad vesimanaych (Bereshit 12:11) hinne na yadati ki ishsha yefat mare att. veshappiru deitteta beinnun shadayim.

Yitzchak deihu semala natil hahu hechala (pikkude 256 1 deve dina dechol dinin mitarin mittamman rucha deikre zechuta leitchabbera da beda valeashetalemaa da beda lemeheve kolla chad kedka yeot. shear neviim natlin teren hechalin 0), terin ruchin noga vezohar, beraza dichtiv, (Shir HaShirim 7:2) chamuke yerechayich vegomer leitkashshera illen beillen lemeheve chad.

Yosef hatztzaddik ammuda dealma (pikkude 258 1) natil hechala desappir rucha deikre livnat hassappir, veaf al gav dichtiv, (Shemot 24:10) vetachat raglav, begin yekara demalka, vehachi hu vadday. ulevatar ammuda da natil yattir deihu raza derazin beatar dehechala sheviaa. ad hacha mitchabberan dargin umitchabberan da beda leishtallama da im da lemeheve kulhu chad. kolla kedka chaze. ucheden (Melachim 1 18:39) Adonai hu haelohim vegomer. zakkaa chulakeh bealma den uvealma deate man deyada lekashra lon uleitdabbeka bemareh.

Hakka hakkeraa (davar acher 33 behacheraa hacha umosif 77) vehishtachavaa, vekida, uferisu dekappin, unefila deappin leamshacha reuta derucha illaa nishmata dechol nishmatin deihu talya leela ad en sof. (davar acher 33 sof) deminneh nafke nehiru uvirchan leashlama kolla milleela kedka yaut. ulemeheve kolla bishlimu mittatta umilleela vechol anpin nehirin bechol sitrin kedka yaut. keden kol gizre dinin mitbatlin vechol reuta itavid leela vetatta. veal da ketiv, (Yeshayahu 49:3) vayyomer li avdi atta yisrael asher becha etpaer. uchetiv, (Tehillim 144:15) ashre haam shekkacha lo ashre haam sheAdonai elohav:

Hekkala sheviaa hekkala da lav beh diukena mammash, kolla ihu bistimu vegomer (davar acher go) raza derazin, parucheta difrisa (davar acher perisa) kayymin kulhu hechalin dela leitchazzaa terin keruvim (davar acher 33 da min da kayymin), lego min da kayyma kappureta diukena dekodesh kudeshin, begin kach hechala da ikre kodesh hakkodashim. hay kodesh hakkodashim atar mittakna lehahu nishmata illaa kelala decholla alma deate legabbe hay (nusach acher alma) illae.

Deha kad mitchabberan kulhu ruche da beda veishtallimu da im da kedka chaze, keden itar rucha illaa nishmata decholla legabbe ela setima dechol setimin, leatara al kolla leanhara lon meela letatta. uleashlama lon leadlaka botzinin.

Vechad kolla (nusach acher ihu) bishlimu binhiru decholla venachit nehiru illaa, keden hay hechala sheviaa ihu hechala setimaa bistimu decholla lekabbela hahu kodesh hakkodashim nehiru denachit uleitmalyay mittamman kenukeva demitabbera min dechura veitmalyay, vela itmalyay ella mehay hechala demittakna lekabbela hahu nehiru illaa, veraza da hechala sheviaa ihu atar dechibbura deziuuga, leitchabbera sheviaa bishviaa lemeheve
89: Kolla chad shelimu (davar acher chad) kedka chaziyi.

Uman deyada lekashra yichuda da zakkaa chulakeh rachim leela rachim letatta kudesha berich hu (ihu) gazir veihu mevattel. salka datin deihu mekatrega bemareh, lav hachi, ella begin dechad ihu kashir keshirin veyada leyachada yichuda vechol anpin nehirin vechol shelimu ishtechach vecholla itbarcha kedka yaut, kol dinin mitabberin umitbattelin vela ishtechach dina bealma. zakkaa chulakeh bealma den uvealma deate. da hu letatta dichtiv beh (Mishlei 10:25) vetzaddik yesod olam da hu kiyyuma dealma. bechol yoma kare aloy karoza (Yeshayahu 41:16) veatta tagil baAdonai bikdosh yisrael tithallal.

Kegavvna da karbana (davar acher 33 da) salka tenana umistappekin (davar acher beh) kol chad vechad kidkachaze leh, vechahani biruta velevae bivsimu deshirata. da itkelil beda, veayyle hechala behechala rucha berucha ad demitchabberan beduchetayyhu kedka chaze leh shayyfa beshayyfa veishtallimu da beda veityaychadu da beda ad deinnun chad (davar acher 33) (vaatanehareyn) venaharin da beda.

Keden nishmata illaa decholla atya milleela venahir lon, vehavu nehirin kulhu botzinin bishlimu kedka chaze, ad dehahu nehora illaa itar vecholla ail legabbe kodesh hakkodashim, veitbarcha veitmalyay kevera demayin navin vela paskin, vechulhu. mitbarchan leela vetatta.

Hacha raza derazin, hahu dela ityeyda vela ail bechushebna. reuta dela itpas lealmin besim lego lego begavvavyyhu, vela ityeyda hahu reuta vela itpas leminda (davar acher 33) (lan) ucheden kolla reuta chada ad en sof vecholla ihu bishlimu mittatta umilleela umiggo lego. ad deitavid kolla chad.

Hay reuta la ail lego af al gav dela ityeyda ad decholla ishtelim veitnehir bekadmita bechulhu sitrin. keden basim hahu reuta (davar acher 33) (lecholla) vela (davar acher dela) itpas lego bego bistimu, ucheden zakkaa chulakeh man deyitdabbak bemareh behahi shaata, zakkaa ihu leela zakkaa ihu letatta ale ketiv, (Mishlei 23:25) yismach avicha veimmecha vetagel yoladtecha.

Ta chaze, kevan dechulhu ishtallimu da beda veitkkashsheru da beda bekishshura chada venishmata illaa nahir lon missitra dilela, vechullehu nehorin innun botzina chada bishlimu, keden raava chada demachashava (davar acher bemachashava) itpas (davar acher lego lego dinhiru desalik al kolla uvego lego behahu reuta bemachashava itpas) nehiru dela itpas vela ityeyda bar hahu reu demachashava tafis vela yada ma tafis ella deitnehir veitbassam hahu reu demachashava veitmalyay kolla veishtelim kolla veitnehir veitbassam kolla kedka yaut. veal da ketiv, (Tehillim 144:15) ashre haam shekkacha lo vegomer.

Man dezache leitdabbeka bemareh kehay gavvna, yarit almin kulhu, rechima leela rechima letatta, tzeloteh la ahaddera rekanya, da itchatte kamme mareh kivra kamme avoy veavid leh reuta bechol ma deitzterich, veemteh shallit al kol biryayn ihu gazir vekudesha berich hu avid. aleh ketiv, (Iyov 22:28) vetigzar omer veyakam lach veal derachecha naga or:

(Nidpas beresh zohar chodesh) vayyomer elohim yehi or vayhi or vegomer. amar rabbi yitzchak mikkan deakaran kudesha berich hu lehani netian (davar acher vashetayl lon mashma dichtiv yehe. rabbi yehuda omer or shekkevar haya tenan, mashma dichtiv vayhi or, vehaya lo ketiv ella vayhi. vechad istakkal kudesha berich hu beinnun darin dareshayayya. ganiz leh letzaddikayyay hada hu dichtiv, (tehillim tzav) or zeroa latztzaddik uleyishre lev simcha veha ittemar, vayyomer elohim yehe or, hada hu dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 41:2) mi hair mimmizrach vegomer.

Vayyar elohim et haur ki tov. may raa, amar rabbi chiyyay kidkamran chama beovadayyhu dareshayayya veganiz leh. rabbi abba amar vayyar elohim et haur ki tov lagenavez oto. vayyar elohim et haur), (nusach acher vashetayl lon dichtiv vayhi or may mashma or shekkevar haya or. rabbi yehuda omer or lo neemar ella vayhi lomar shekkevar haya uchetiv or zeroa latztzaddik vegomer vehay hu dichtiv mi hair mimmizrach vegomer. vayyar elohim et haur vayyavdel amar rabbi yitzchak kedaamaran dechama baavabedayyhevan dareshayayya veganiz leh. rabbi abba amar chama) desalik nehoreh misyayfe alma ad seyayfe alma, vechi tov hu
90: Leagnaza leh dela yehenun minneh chayyayve alma.

Amar rabbi shimon vayyar elohim et haor ki tov dela yishtechach beh ritcha, ketiv hacha ki tov uchetiv hatam (Bamidbar 24:1) ki tov beene Adonai levarech et yisrael, vesofa dikra (davar acher ochach) vayyavdel elohim ben haor uven hachoshech, ubbegin kach la ishtechach beh ritcha veaf al gav deshittef lon kudesha berich hu kechada.

Ta chaze, nehiru illaa lemehve nahir hay or. umehahu nehiru chadu lecholla beh. vehu yamina leitattera gulefoy (nusach acher galeypey) gelifin bahadeh veha ittemar. ketiv, (Tehillim 31:20) ma rav tuvecha asher tzafanta lireecha paalta lachosim bach. ma rav tuvecha da or kadmaa deganiz kudesha berich hu, lireecha latztzaddikim leinnun dachale chattaa kidkaamaran.

Vayhi erev vayhi voker yom echad. vayhi erev missitra dechoshech, vayhi voker missitra deor, umiggo deinnun mishtattefe kechada ketiv yom echad. rabbi yehuda amar may taama bechol yoma veyoma ketiv vayhi erev vayhi voker. leminda deha let yom bela layla velet layla bela yom vela ivun leitperasha.

Amar rabbi yose hahu yom denafak or kadmaa itpeshat bechulhu yome, dichtiv bechulhu yom. amar rabbi elazar mashma dichtiv bechulhu boker, velav boker ela missitra deor kadmaa. rabbi shimon amar yoma kadmaa azil im kulhu vechulhu beh, begin leachazaa delav behu piruda vecholla chad.

Vayyomer elohim yehi or, yehi (davar acher lageaver) itpashtuta dehay or letatta, veillen innun malachin deitberiu beyoma kadmaa it lon kiyyuma leitkayyma listar yamina. vayyar elohim et haor ki tov. et leitkelala ispaklaryaa dela nahara im ispaklaryaa denahara deittemar (davar acher beh) ki tov. amar rabbi elazar et leitkelala (davar acher leachlela) uleasgaa kulhu malachin deatyayn missitra deor da, vechulhon naharin kekadmita bekiyyuma shelim:
Yehi rakia betoch hammayim, amar rabbi yehuda behay itperashu (Bereshit 32 2, 17 2) mayyin illain mimmayin tattain. rakia peshituta demayyin veha ittemar. vihi mavdil ben mayyin illain letattain:
Vayyaas elohim et harakia. bisgiu illaa. vayhi rakia la ketiv, ella vayyaas, deasge leh birvu sagya.

Amar rabbi yitzchak bashsheni itbere gehinnom lechayyayve alma, bashsheni itbere machloket. bashsheni la ishtelim beh avidta, ubbegin kach la ketiv beh ki tov, ad deata yom telitaa veishtelim beh avidta, begin kach ki tov tere zimne, chad al ashlamut avidta deyom sheni, vechad legarmeh. beyom telitae ittakkan yom sheni veitperash beh machloket. uveh ishtelimu rachame al chayyayve gehinnom. beyoma telitaa mishtakkechin shevivin degehinnom. begine kach itkelil beh yom sheni veishtelim beh.

Rabbi chiyyay hava yativ kammeh derabbi shimon, amar leh hay or beyom rishon vechoshech beyom sheni veitperashu maya umachloket hava beh, ammay la ishtelim beyom rishon dehay yamina kalil lismala, amar leh al da hava machloket, utelitaa bae lemeal benayyhu leachraa uleasgaa behu shelam:

Tadshe haaretz deshe, itchabberuta demayyin illain betattain lemebad perin. mayin illain (davar acher perin veravin) veavde ibbin, vetattae karan lon leillain kenukeva legabbe dechura, begin demayin illain dechurin vetattae nukevin.

Rabbi shimon amar kol da hu leela vehu letatta. amar rabbi yose i hachi elohim deka amaran (davar acher amar) man elohim, (davar acher 33 ella elohim setam) elohim chayyim leela, vei tema letatta elohim setam. ella letatta ihu toldot,
91: Kema deat amer elle toldot hashshamayim vehaaretz behibbaram veamrinan baAdonai beraam, vehahu (sefer acher dilella) leela avahan decholla hu ihi avidta, veal da ara avdat toldot, deha hi mitabbera kenukeva min dechura.

Rabbi elazar amar kol chelin havu beara vela appikat chelaha veinnun toldoteha ad yom (chamishi) hashshishshi dichtiv totze haaretz nefesh chayya, vei tema veha ketiv vattotze haaretz deshe. ella afikat tikkun chelaha leityayshva kedka yaut vecholla hava ganiz be ad deitzterich. deha bekadmita ketiv tzadyay verekanya ketargumo, ulevatar ittakkanat veityayshvat vekabbilat zara udeshain veisvin veilanin kedka yaut, veappikat lon levatar. umeorot hachi name la shimshu nehora dilhon ad deitzterich:

Yehi meorot birkia hashshamayim (davar acher meorot ketiv chaser), leachlala chivya visha deattil zuhama veavad piruda dela meshammesh shimsha besihara. meorot levavtin, veal da garim deitlatyay ara dichtiv arura haadama, uvegin kach meorot ketiv, (chad),

Yehi meorot da sihara. rekia hashshamayim da shimsha, vetarvavyyhu bichlala chada leizdavvga leanhara almin leela vetatta. mashma dichtiv al haaretz vela ketiv baaretz demashma leela vetatta, chusheban decholla besihara hu.

Rabbi shimon amar gimatriyyaot vecheshbon tekufot veibburin kolla hu besihara, deha leela lav ihu. amar leh rabbi elazar vela veha kamma chushebnin veshiurin kaavde chavrayay. amar leh lav hachi, ella chushebana kayyma besihara umittamman yeul bar nash leminda leela. amar leh veha ketiv vehayu leotot ulemoadim. amar leh leotot ketiv chaser. amar leh ha ketiv vehayu, amar leh haveyayn kulhon dihavon beh, keispuka da deitmalyay mikkolla, aval chushebna decholla besihara hu.

Ta chaze, nekuda chad it umittamman sheruta lemimne, deha ma dilgo dehahi nekuda la ityeda vela ityeyhav lemimne, veit nekuda leela satim dela itgalya kelal vela ityeda umittamman sheruta lemimni kol satim veumeka. hachi name it nekuda letatta deitgalya, umittamman hu sheruta lechol chushebna ulechol minyan, veal da hacha hu atar lechol tekufot vegimatriyyaot veibburin vezimnin vechagge veshabbatte. veyisrael dedavke bekudesha berich hu avde chusheban lesihara veinnun davkin beh vesalkin leh leela, dichtiv, (Devarim 4:4) veattem haddevekim baAdonai elokechem vegomer:
Yishretzu hammayim sheretz nefesh chaya, amar rabbi elazar ha ukemuha deinnun mayin rechishu veolidu kegavvna dilela veha ittemar. veof yeofef al haaretz. yauf mibbae leh, mahu yeofef.

Amar rabbi shimon raza hu. veof da michael dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 6:6) vayyaaf elay echad min hasserafim. yeofef (davar acher 33 yauf mibbae leh ella) da gavriel dichtiv, (Daniel 9:21) vehaish gavriel asher raiti vechazon battechilla muaf biaf. (davar acher 33 veda hu yeofef), al haaretz (nusach acher da eliyyahu deishtechach tadir beara velo missitra deabba veima ishtechach deihu 4 6 taasayn dichtiv, 5 veruach Adonai yashshiacha al asher lo eda. veruach Adonai chad. yashshiacha teren. al asher telat, lo eda arba. al pene da malach hammavet) dehu (it dela garse) (chashuch ara. al pene) (nusach acher acheshaych pene alma uchetiv beh vechoshech al pene tehom), rekia hashshamayim. kidamaran ole umastin vechulei.

Amar rabbi abba veha malach hammavet bashsheni itbere. ella al haaretz da refael deihu memanna leasvavta deara divgineh itrappiat ara vekayyaym bar nash alah verafe lechol cheleh. al peni rekia hashshamayim da oriel, vecholla hu bakkera.

Uvegin kach ketiv batreh vayyivra elohim et hattanninim haggedolim. amar rabbi elazar (davar acher ha okimna illen livyatan uvat zugo.) illen innun shivin memannan ravrevan al shivin ammin, uvegin kach itberiu kulhu lemeheve shallitan al ara.
Veet kol nefesh hachayya haromeset illen innun yisrael deinnun
92: Nefesh vadday dehahu chayya veikrun goy echad baaretz. asher shartzu hammayim leminehem deinnun mishtaddelin beorayyta. veet kol of kanaf leminehu illen tzaddikayyay divhon uvegin kach innun nefesh chayya. davar acher veet kol of kanaf kedka ittemar illen innun (leel lod 1) sheluche alma.

Amar rabbi abba nefesh chayya deinnun (davar acher innun) yisrael, begin deinnun bene dekudesha berich hu (davar acher benin lekudesha berich hu) venishmathon kaddishin minneh atyayn. nafshan dishar ammin ovde avodat kochavim umazzalot mean atar hu. amar rabbi elazar meinnun sitre semala dimsaave lon it lon nishmatin. uvegin kach kulhu mesaavin, umesaavin leman dekarav bahadayyhu:

Vayyomer elohim totze haaretz nefesh chayya vegomer kulhon shear chevavn ochoranin kol chad vechad kefum zineh, veamar rabbi elazar hay mesayyea lema deamaran nefesh chayya illen yisrael deinnun nefesh chayya kaddisha illaa. behema varemes vechayto eretz illen shear amin ovde avodat kochavim umazzalot delav innun nefesh chayya ella (davar acher arla) kidkaamaran:

Naase adam betzalmenu kidmutenu, deitkelil beshit sitrin kalil mikkolla kegavvna dilela, beshayyfe metaknan beraza dechachmeta kedka yaut kolla tikkuna illaa. naase adam raza dechar venukeva kolla bechachmeta kaddisha illaa. betzalmenu kidmutenu leishtachlela da beda lemehevi (davar acher 33 chad) hu yechiday bealma shallit al kolla:

Vayyar elohim et kol asher asa (davar acher kelal) vehinne tov meod, hacha ittakkan ma dela ittemar ki tov bashsheni begin deitbere beh mota, vehacha ittemar vehinne tov meod. veazla kema deamre chavrayay vehinne tov meod ze mavet.

Vayyar elohim et kol asher asa vehinne tov meod, vechi la chama leh kodem. ella kolla chama leh kudesha berich hu, uman deamar et kol, leasgaa kol darin deyetun levatar ken, vechen kol ma deyitchaddesh bealma bechol dara vedara ad la yetun lealma. asher asa, da kol ovadin divreshit, detamman itbere yesoda veikkera lechol ma deyete veyitchaddesh bealma levatar ken. uvegin kach chama leh kudesha berich hu ad la hava veshavve kolla beovada divreshit.

Yom hashshishshi, may shena bechulhu yome dela ittemar behu hei, ella hacha kad ishtachlal alma itchabberat nukeva bidchura bechibbura chad, Adonai bashshishshi (davar acher deihu sefer acher yesod) lemeheve kolla chad. vaychullu, ishtachlelu chola chad (davar acher kechad). ishtachlelu mikkolla veishtalimu becholla:

Vaychullu hashshamayim vehaaretz vechol tzevaam. rabbi elazar patach (Tehillim 31:20) ma rav tuvecha asher tzafanta lireecha paalta lachosim bach neged bene adam. ta chaze, kudesha berich hu bara levar nash bealma, veatkin leh lemehve shelim befulechanih uleittakkana archoy, begin deyizke linhora illaa deganiz kudesha berich hu letzaddikayyay kema deat amer, (Yeshayahu 64:3) ayin lo raata elohim zulatcha yaase limchakke lo.

Uvemma (sefer acher zache bar nash) yizke leh levar nash lehahu nehora, beorayyta. dechol man deishtaddal beorayyta bechol yoma yizke lemehve leh chuleka bealma deate, veyitchashev leh keillu vane almin, deha beorayyta itbene alma veishtachlal hada hu dichtiv, (Mishlei 3:19) Adonai bechachma yasad eretz konin shamayim bitvuna, uchetiv, (Mishlei 8:30) vaehye etzlo amon vaehye shaashuim yom yom vechol deishtaddal bah shachlil almin vekayyim leh. veta chaze, berucha avid kudesha berich hu alma, uverucha mitkayyma, rucha deinnun delaan beorayyta, vechol shekken rucha dehevel deravye deve rav.

Ma rav tuvecha da tuva deitgeniz. lireecha leinnun dachale chattaa. paalta lachosim bach. may paalta da ovada divreshit. rabbi abba amar da gan eden, deha beumanuta avid leh kudesha berich hu beara kegavvna dilela. leittakfa beh tzaddikayyay
93: Hada hu dichtiv (Tehillim 31:20) paalta lachosim bach, neged bene adam, deha hu neged (bene) adam. veachara neged illain kaddishin. amar rabbi shimon gan eden leela veneged bene adam have (vaafillu achara neged bene adam have) leitkansha beh tzaddikayyay deavde reuta demarehon.

Vaychullu, dechalu ovadin dilela veovadin diltatta. hashshamayim vehaaretz leela vetatta. rabbi shimon amar ovada veumanuta deorayyta shebbichtav veovada veumanuta detora shebbeal pe. vechol tzevaam illen perate deorayyta appin deorayyta shivim panim lattora. vaychullu, deitkayyeymu veishtachlelu da beda. shamayim vaaretz perat uchelal. vechol tzevaam, raze deorayyta dachyan deorayyta mesaavan deorayyta.

Vaychal elohim bayyom hashshevii da tora shebbeal pe deihu yom shevii, uveh ishtachlal alma deihu kiyyuma decholla. melachto asher asa velo kol melachto, deha tora shebbichtav appik kolla betukefa dichtav denafik mechachmeta.

Telat zimnin hacha bayyom hashshevii. vaychal elohim bayyom hashshevii. vayyishbot bayyom hashshevii. vayvarech elohim et yom hashshevii. ha telat. vaychal elohim bayyom hashshevii, da tora shebbeal pe, deim yom hashshevii da ishtachlal alma kedka amaran.

Vayyishbot bayyom hashshevii, da yesoda dealma. besifra derav yeva sava da yovla veal kach ketiv hacha mikkol melachto decholla nafik minneh. veanan da yesoda kidkaamaran deha nayycha beh hava yattir mikkolla.

Vayvarecha elohim et yom hashshevii. da kohen gadol dimvarech lecholla vehu natil beresha ditnan kohen notel barosh, uvirchan beh sharyayn levarcha veikre shevii. rabbi yesa sava amar hani tere chad bisoda dealma ihu, vechad beammuda deemtzaita. (davar acher 33) (aval hane telat chad bemaale shabbeta delelya vechad deyoma vechad dealma deate deihu shabbat haggadol).

Vechen (davar acher 33 vaykaddesh) oto, leman, lehahu atar deat kayyayma beh sharya kema deat amer, (Shmuel 2 15:25) vehirani oto veet navihu. uvehay atar sharyayn kol kidushin leela (davar acher dilella), venafke minneh lichneset yisrael lemehav lah tafnuka lechem pannag, veazla ha kema dichtiv, (Bereshit 49:20) measher shemena lachmo vehu yitten maadanne melech, measher da keyaym shelim dehava (davar acher 33) (leh) lechem oni ithaddar lemehve lechem pannag. vehu yitten maadanne melech. man melech, da kenset yisrael. hu yahiv (davar acher la) kol tafnukin dealmin, vechol kiddushin denafkin milleela mehay atar nafkin. veal da vaykaddesh oto, hahu at kayyayma.

Ki vo shavat. beh nayycha decholla, (davar acher beh nayycha) deillain vetattain. beh shabbatta (davar acher atyay) lenayycha. asher bara elohim mikkelala dezachur nafka shamor leatkana avidta dealma. laasot da omana dealma. lemebad avidta decholla. (sefer acher asher bara umana itzterich lealma vechol avidta decholla).

Tu parish rabbi shimon milla veamar, ketiv, (Devarim 7:9) shomer habberit vehachesed. shomer da keneset yisrael. habberit da yesoda dealma. vehachesed da avraham, dichneset yisrael hi shomer habberit vehachesed, veikre shomer yisrael, da hu natir pitcha decholla, beh talyayn kol avidan dealma vadday, asher bara elohim laasot, leshachlela leatkana kolla kol yoma veyoma uleappaka ruchin venishmatin (kaddishin lealma), veafillu ruchin veshedin.

Vei tema delav innun tikkuna dealma. lav hachi. deha innun letikkuna dealma havu ulealkaa behu lechayyayve alma deinnun azlin lekivlayyhu leochacha lehu. umay deazil lismala itachid besitra semala lekivlayyhu (sefer acher lake behu) begine chach letikkuna havu. ta chaze, ma ketiv bishlomo (Shmuel 2 7:14) vehochachtiv beshevet anashim uvenige bene adam. man (169 amud bet) nige beni adam. illen innun mazzikin.
Ta chaze, bishata deitberian itkaddash yoma veishtaaru rucha bela gufa. veillen innun baryayn dela
94: Ishtachlalu (davar acher 33) (velo ateyysadev) umistar semala innun zuhama dedahava, veal da begin dela ishtachlelu veinnun pegimin, shema kaddisha la sharya behu vela itdabbeku beh, udechilu dilhon mishma kaddisha ihu vezain vedachalin minneh, ushema kaddisha la sharya beatar pagim.

Veta chaze hay bar nash deitpegim dela shavak bar behay alma, kad nafak minneh la itdabbak bishma kaddisha (leel 13 1) vela alin leh befargoda, begin deihu pagim vela ishtelim, veilana deitakker baya netia zimna ochora, begin dishma kaddisha ishtelim bechol sitrin. ufegimo la itdabbak beh lealmin.

Veta chaze hane baryayn pegimin innun meela umittatta, uvegini chach la mitdabbekan leela vela mitdabbekan letatta. veillen dichtiv behu asher bara elohim laasot dela ishtallimu ela vetatta. vei tema ha ruchin innun ammay lav (davar acher ishtelimu) leela, ella kevan dela ishtelimu letatta beara la ishtelimu leela. vechulhu missetar semala ka atyayn umitkasyayn meena divne nesha vekayyme lekivlayyhu leavasha lon. telat lon kemalache hashsharet. utelat lon kivne nesha. (leel ko 1) veha ukemuha.

Batar deitberiu ruchin (davar acher 33 atemarev) ishtaaru innun ruchin batar rechayyay denukeva dithoma rabba lelya deshabbatta veyoma deshabbatta, kevan denafak kedushata deyoma vela ishtallimu, nafku lealma veshatan lechol sitrin, uvaya alma leitnattera minnayyhu. deha keden kol setar semala itar, veeshsha degehinnom melahata, vechol innun devistar semala azlin veshatan bealma. uvaan leitlabbesha begufa vela yachlin. keden baena leistammera minnayyhu, veatkinu shir difgaim bechol shaata didchilu dilhon sharya bealma.

Ta chaze, kad itkaddash yoma bemaale shabbatta sukkat shalom sharya veitperisat bealma. man sukkat shalom, da shabbatta, vechol ruchin veilulin veshedin vechol sitra dimsaave kulhu temirin vealin beena derechayyay denukeva dithoma rabba. deha kevan deitar kedushata al alma, ruach mesaava la itar bahadeh. veda arik mikkammeh deda.

Ucheden alma bintiru illaa vela baenan letzallaa al netiru kegon shomer et ammo yisrael laad amen. deha da beyoma dechol ittakkan dealma baya netiru. aval beshabbat sukkat shalom itperisa al alma veitnetir bechol sitrin. veafillu chayyayve gehinnom netirin innun, vecholla bishlama ishtakkecha illain vetattain, ubbegin kach bekiddusha deyoma mevarchinan happores sukkat shalom alenu veal kol amo yisrael veal yerushalam.

Ammay al yerushalam, ella da hi medora dehahi sukka. uvaena lezammena lehahi sukka deitperasat alana ulemeshra immana ulemeheve (davar acher mageynea) alana keimma desharyay al benin, uvegin da la dachalin mikkol sitrin, veal da happores sukkat shalom alenu.

Ta chaze, beshaata deyisrael mevarchin umezammenin lehay sukkat shalom ushepiza kadisha veamre happores sukkat shalom, keden kedushata ilaa nachata uferisat gadfaha alayyhu deyisrael umechasya lon keimma al benin, vechol zinin bishin itkannishu mealma, veyatve yisrael techot kedushata demarehon, ucheden da sukkat shalom yahiv nishmatin chadtin livnaha, may taama begin debeh nishmatin sharyayn (sefer acher dichden zeman ziuuga venittelet nishmatin uvah sharyayn) uminneh nafkin. vechevan desharya uferisat gadfaha al benaha. arikat nishmatin chadtin lechol chad vechad.

Tu amar rabbi shimon al da tanenan shabbat dugema dealma deate ihu, hachi hu vadday, veal da shemita veyovel dugema da beda. veshabbat vealma deate hachi hu. vehahu tosefet denishmeta meraza dezachur ka atya al hay sukkat shalom denatil
95: Mealma deate veda tosefet yahavat lealmma kaddisha. uvehahu tosefet chadan veyitneshe minnayyhu kol millin dechol vechol tzaarin vechol akin kema deat amer (Yeshayahu 14:3) beyom haniach Adonai lecha meatzbecha umeragzecha umin haavoda hakkasha vegomer.

Uvelelya deshabbatta bae bar nash leatama mikkolla, begin leachazaa dehay sukkat shalom mikkolla itkelilat, uvilvad dela yafgim mechla chada leyoma, veit deamre teren, litren seudate ochoranin deyoma, veshappir. vechol shekken i salik yattir leyoma veyachil lemitam mimmechlin ochoranin velizire bitre tavshilin sagya, veukemuha chavraya.

Ner shel shabbat linshe amma kaddisha ityeyhivat leadlaka, vechavrayay ha amru deihi kibbeta botzina dealma veachashichat leh kulei veshappir. aval raza demilla. hay sukkat shalom matronita dealma hi venishmatin deinnun botzina illaa bah sharyayn. veal da matronita baaya leadlaka, deha beduchetaha itachdat vaavadat ovada.

Veitteta baaya bechedva delibba ureuta leadlaka botzina deshabbat, deha yekara illaa hi lah uzechu rav legarmah lemizke livnin kaddishin dihon botzina dealma beorayyta uvedachalta, veyisgon shelama beara, vihevat levaalah orka dechayyin, begin kach baaya leizdahara bah.

Ta chaze, shabbat lelya veyoma zachor veshamor ihu kechada, veal da ketiv zachor et yom hashshabbat lekadsho uchetiv shamor et yom hashshabbat, zachor lidchura shamor lenukeva vecholla chad. zakkain innun yisrael chulakeh dekudesha berich hu adveh veachasanteh alayyhu ketiv, (Tehillim 144:15) ashre haam shekkacha lo ashre haam sheAdonai elokav.

Vayyiven Adonai elohim et hatztzela asher lakach min haadam vegomer. amar rabbi shimon ketiv, (Iyov 28:23-24) elohim hevin darkah vehu yada et mekomah. hay kera gevavnin saggiin it beh. ella mahu elohim hevin darkah. kema deat amer vayyiven Adonai elohim et hatztzela da tora shebbaal pe deit bah derech, kema deat amer, (Yeshayahu 43:16) hannoten bayyam derech, begine kach elohim hevin darkah.

Vehu yada et mekomah. man mekomah, da tora shebbichtav deit bah daat. (daat utevuna kechad azlu) Adonai elohim shem male leatkana lah becholla. veal da itkeriat chachma veitkeriat bina. begin dehava beshem male Adonai elohim becholla bishlimu bitre shemahan.

Et hatztzela da aspaklarya dela nahara kema deat amer, (Tehillim 35:15) uvetzali samchu veneesafu. asher lakach min haadam, begin deha mittora shebbichtav nafkat. leishsha, leitkashshera beshalhova distar semala, deha orayyta missitra digvura ityehivat. leishsha, lemeheve (58 70 1) esh Adonai katir kechada.

Vayvieha el haadam. begin dela baaya leishtakkacha bilchudaha ella leitkelala uleitchabbera battora shebbichtav. kevan deitchabberat bahadeh hu yazun lah vitakken lah veyitten lah ma deitzterich hayeynu dichtiv veet haaretz veha okimna. mikkan olifna man deansiv beratteh ad la teul levaalah, avuha veimmah metakkenin lah veyahavin lah kol ma deitzterich, kevan deitchabberat bevaalah hu yazun lah vehu yitten lah ma devaya.

Ta chaze, bekadmita ketiv vayyiven Adonai elohim et hatztzela. deabba veimma atkinu lah (26 kishshutin. vayvieha 15 24) ulevatar vayvieha el haadam (vaaalea leh bechamesh kalin 1 kol sason vekol simcha kol chatan vekol kullah kol mitzhalot chatanim) leitkashshera kolla kechada uleitchabbera chad bechad. vehu yahiv (leh) ma deitzterich.

Davar acher elohim hevin darkah, kad beratta beve imma, hi istakkela bechol yoma bechol ma devaaya berattah dichtiv, (Iyov 28:23) elohim hevin darkah, kevan dechavrat lah bevaalah hu yahiv lah kol ma devaaya vitakken ovadaha, hada hu dichtiv vehu yada et mekomah (vehay kera berazin illain itkeshar) (davar acher hay kera al chachmeta illaa ittemar veitkeshar berazin illain, deha nekuda kadmaa let man deyada bah kelal, aval elohim hevin darkah da alma deate, 18 da temira dechol temirin setima deikre 12 velo yedia bishma).
96: Ketiv vayyitzer Adonai elohim et haadam. hacha ishtachlal becholla beyamina uvismala, veha okimna deitkelil beyetzer hattov, aval vayyitzer Adonai elohim beyetzer tov uveyetzer ra. ammay, ella yetzer tov leh legarmeh. yetzer hara leatara legabbe nukeve. (sefer acher vamesater semala ittear tadir legabbe nukeba), raza demilla mikkan olifna detzafon itar tadir legabbe nukeva veitkashshar bahadah uvegin kach itkeriat ishsha.

Veta chaze, yetzer tov veyetzer hara begin deityayhavat nukeva benayyhu (nusach acher denukeba itkelilat behu) veitkashshera bahadayyhu, vela mitkashshera ad deyetzer hara itar legabbah umitkashsheran da beda. vechevan demitkashsheran da beda, keden itar yetzer tov deihu chedva veayyte lah legabbeh (ucheden ateyyhabet benayyhu leatkena, veal da vayyitzer Adonai elohim sham male legabbeh yetzer tov veyetzer ra) (davar acher uleella sitra detzafon mammash deihi chedva belo zuhama deyetzer hara achid bah bekadmita, dichtiv, 2 semolo tachat leroshi ulevatar vimino techabbekeni, veityeyhivat ben yemina usemala leittezana, veal da vayyitzer Adonai elohim sham male legabbe teren sitrin illen).

Et haadam ha okimna. aval dechar venukeva kechada (davar acher velo havo) mitparshan lemehve appin beappin. ma ketiv afar min haadama hasheta kayyma leatkana. ta chaze itteta kad itchabberat bevaalah, itkeriat al shem baalah, ish ishsha, tzaddik tzedek, ihu ofer veihi afar. (davar acher 33) (ucheden) ihu tzevi veihi tzeviya (davar acher kema deat amar) (Yechezkel 20:6) tzevi hi lechol haaratzot.

Ketiv, (Devarim 16:21) lo titta lecha ashera kol etz etzel mizbach Adonai elohecha asher taase lach. etzel mizbach, vechi leela minneh o beatar ochora man sharyay. ella ha okimna (182 amud bet) asher da baalah deitteta (davar acher hei) itkeriat al shum baalah ashera. (nusach acher hah hem asher hei) veal da ketiv, (Melachim 2 23:4) labbaal velaashera. begin kach ketiv lo titta lecha ashera kol etz etzel mizbach Adonai elokecha. lokovel (nusach acher ashera) atar dehahu mizbach Adonai, deha mizbach Adonai ihu kayyma al da, veal da lokovla lo titta lecha ashera ochora.

Ta chaze, bechol atar kol innun palche shimsha ikrun ovdin labbaal, veinnun defalchin lesihara ikrun ovde ashera, veal da labbaal velaashera, vaashera itkere al shum baalah asher. i hachi ammay itavar shema da. ella ashera al shum dichtiv (Bereshit 30:13) beashri ki ishruni vanot vehu (davar acher ha) dela ashruha shear ammin vekayyma ochora techotah, vela od ella dichtiv (Eicha 1:8) kol mechabbedeha hizziluha, ubbegin kach (nusach acher itavid) itavar shema da, uvegin dela yittakkefun innun deavde shear amin ovde avodat kochavim umazzalot, vekarenan mizbeach deihu meadama, dichtiv, (Shemot 20:21) mizbach adama vegomer begine kach afar min haadama.

Vayyippach beappav nishmat chayyim. (milla itkelil aval vayyippach beappav) itkelil nishmat chayyim behahu afar, kenukeva demitabbera min dechura deha mitchabberan veitmalyay hay afar mikkolla, umay ihu, ruchin venishmatin. vayhi haadam lenefesh chayya, hasheta ittakkan vekayyaym adam leatkana ulemezan lenefesh chayya.

Vayyiven Adonai elohim, uf hachi name beshem male, deha abba veimma atkinu lah ad la atat levaalah. et hatztzela kema deat amer, (Shir HaShirim 1:Adonai) shechora ani venava benot yerushalam, aspaklarya dela nahara, aval abba veimma atkinu lah leitpayaysa baalah bahadah.

Vayvieha el haadam. mehacha olifna devaan abba veimma dechalla leoola birshuteh dechatan. kema deat amer, (Devarim 22:16) et bitti natatti laish hazze vegomer. mikkan vaelach baalah yete legabbah, deha beta dilah hu dichtiv, (Bereshit 29:30) vayyavo eleha. vayyavo gam el rachel, bekadmita vayvieha el haadam dead hacha it leabba uleimma lemeevad, levatar ihu yete legabbah vechol beta dilah hu, veyittol reshut minah.
Veal da itarna dichtiv, (Bereshit 28:11) vayyifga bammakom vayyalen sham, denatil reshu bekadmita. mikkan olifna deman demitchabber
97: Beinteteh bae lemifga lah ulevasma lah bemillin, vei lav la (148 2) yavit legabbah. begin dihe reuta dilhon kechada bidla anisu.

Vayyalen sham ki va hashshemesh, leachazaa deasir leh levar nash leshamsha arseh bimama. vayyikkach meavne hammakom vayyasem meraashotav, hacha olifna daafilu yehon lemalka arse dedahava ulevushe yekar lemevat behu umatronita tatken leh arsa mittakkan beavnin, yishbok dileh veyavet bamme deihi tatkin dichtiv vayyishkav bammakom hahu.

Ta chaze, ma ketiv hacha vayyomer haadam zot happaam vegomer. ha besimu demillin leamshecha immah chavivuta, uleamshacha lah (immah) liruteh leatara immah rechimuta. chame kamma besimin innun millin, kamma mille dirchimuta innun, etzem meatzamay uvasar mibbesari, begin leachazaa lah deinnun chad vela it piruda benayyhu becholla.

Hasheta share leshabbacha lah. lezot yikkare ishsha da hi dela yishtakkach kavvavtah. da hi yekara deveta kullehon nashin gabbah kekofa bifne beni nasha. aval lezot yikkare ishsha shelimu decholla lezot vela leachara. kolla hu male rechimuta kema deat amer, (Mishlei 31:29) rabbot banot asu chayil veat alit al kullana:

Al ken yaazav ish et aviv veet immo vedavak beishto vehayu levasar echad, kolla leamshacha lah birchimu uleitdabbeka bahadah, kevan deitar legabbah kol millin illen, ma ketiv vehannachash haya arum vegomer. ha itar yetzer hara leachada bah begin lekashra lah betiuveta degufa uleatara legabbah millin ochoranin deyetzer hara itannag behu.

Ad levatar ma ketiv vatere haishsha ki tov haetz lemaachol vechi taava hu laenayim vattikkach mippiryo vattochal, kevelat leh biruta vattitten gam leishah immah (veyochal) ha keden hi itara legabbeh betiuveta (nusach acher betiuveta) leatara (nusach acher lemehav) leh reuta urechimu, da milla leachazaa ovada livne nasha kegavvna dilela.

Amar rabbi elazar i hachi bemay nokim leh leela yetzer hara deachid bah benukeva, amar leh, ha itara illen leela veillen letatta yetzer tov veyetzer ra. yetzer tov miyyamina veyetzer ra mismala, usemala leela achid benukeva lekashra lah kechada (nusach acher leitkashshera beh) begufa kema deat amer, (Shir HaShirim 2:6) semolo tachat leroshi vegomer, veal da millin itparshan leela vetatta ad hacha, mikkan ulehala millin bezutera (nusach acher bazevatea) dezifta lizireh detinkin lefarsha milla, veha itaru beh chavrayyay.

Rabbi shimon hava azil litverya, vehavu immeh rabbi yose verabbi yehuda verabbi chiyyay. addehachi chamu leh lerabbi pinchas dehava ate. kevan deitchabbaru kechada, nachatu veyatvu techot ilana chad meilane tura. amar rabbi pinchas ha yativna, meillen mille maalyayta deat amer bechol yoma beena lemishma.

Patach rabbi shimon veamar (Bereshit 13:3) vayyelech lemassaav minnegev vead bet el ad hammakom asher haya sham oholo battechilla ben bet el uven haay. vayyelech lemassaav, lemassao mibbae leh. may lemassaav. ella teren matlanin innun. chad dideh vechad dishchinta. deha kol bar nash bae leishtakkecha dechar venukeva begin leatkafa mehemnuta. ucheden shechinta la itparsha minneh lealmin.

Vei tema man denafik leorcha dela ishtechach dechar venukeva, shechinta itparsha minnih. ta chaze, hay man denafik learcha (168 1) yesadder tzelota kamme kudesha berich hu. begin leamshacha aleh shechinta demareh ad la yippuk learcha bezimna deishtechach dechar venukeva. kevan desaddar tzeloteh veshivcheh ushechinta sharyay aleh yippuk. deha shechinta izdavvgat bahadeh. begin deyishtechach dechar venukeva. dechar venukeva bemata. dechar venukeva bechakla. hada hu dichtiv, (Tehillim 85:14) tzedek lefanav yehallech veyasem lederech peamav.
98: Zimna devar nash itakkav beorcha (bechol cheleh) bae lenatra ovadoy. begin deziuuga illaa la yitperash minneh veyishtechach pagim bela dechar venukeva. bemata itzterich kad nukeveh immeh, kol sheken hacha deziuuga illaa itkashsherat beh. vela od ella deha ziuuga illaa natir leh bearcha vela mitparsha minneh ad deyitov leveteh.

Beshaata deal leveteh baa lechadta devithu (beteh). begin didvithu garma leh hahu ziuuga illaa. kevan deata legabbah bae lechadta lah begin teren gavvne. chad begin chedvata dehahi ziuvga chedvavta demitzva hi vechedvavta demitzva chedvavta dishchinta ihu.

Vela od ella deasge shalom setam (letatta) (nusach acher leitteta) hada hu dichtiv, (Iyov Adonai:24) veyadata ki shalom oholecha, ufakadta navecha velo techota. vechi i la pakid leitteteh chet ihu. hachi hu vadday. begin degara yekar ziuuga illaa deizdavvgat beh udevithu garma leh.

Vechad dei mitabbera itteteh ziuuga illaa arikat bah nishmata kaddisha dehay berit ikre berit dekudesha berich hu. veal da bae lechavvna bechedvavta da kema devae bechedvavta deshabbat (deinnun chakkimin) deihu ziuuga dechakkimin. veal da veyadata ki shalom oholecha deha shechinta atya immach vesharya bevetach. veal da (Iyov Adonai:24) ufakadta navecha velo techota. may velo techota. leshammasha kamme shechinta chedvavta demitzva.

Kegavvna da talmide chachamim demitparshan minneshayyhu kol innun yomin deshabbatta begin leitasseka beorayyta. ziuuga illaa izdavvavg behu vela mitparsha minnayyhu begin deyishtechach dechar venukeva. kevan deal shabbat bayayn talmide chachamim lechadta lidvithu begin yekar ziuuga illaa. ulechavvevna libbayyhu biruta demarehon kema deittemar.

Kegavvna da, hay man deitteteh beyome mesaavu dilah venatir lah kedka yeut. kol innun yomin ziuuga illaa izdavvavg bahadeh deyishtechach dechar venukeva. kevan deitdechiat itteteh bae lechadta lah chedva demitzva chedva illaa. vechulhu taame deka amaran bechad darga salkin. setama demilla kol innun beni mehemnuta booyayn lechavvevna libba ureuta behay.

Vei tema i hachi shevacha hu devar nash kad nafik learcha yattir min beteh begin ziuuga illaa deizdavvgat bahadeh. ta chaze, bezimna devar nash hu beveteh, ikkera deveta devithu. begin dishchinta la itadde min beta begin devithu. kema detaninan dichtiv, (Bereshit 24:67) vayvieha yitzchak haohla sara immo, dishragga itdelakat, may tama begin dishchinta atat leveta.

Raza demilla imma illaa la ishtakkechat gabbe dechura ella bezimna deittaknat beta veitchabberu dechar venukeva, keden imma illaa arikat birchan livarukke lon. kegavvna da imma tattaa la ishtakkechat legabbe dechura ella bezimna deittaknat beta veate dechar legabbah denukeveh veitchabbaru kechada keden imma tattaa arikat birchan levarcha lon.

Veal da bitre nukevin itattar dechura beveteh kegavvna dilela. vehayeynu raza dichtiv, (Bereshit 49:26) ad taavat givot olam. hay 74 tiuveta degivot olam beh. nukeva illaa leatkana leh uleaattera leh ulevarcha leh. nukeva tattaa leitchabbera beh uleitzena minneh.

Uchegavvna da letatta kad dechura insiv, taavat givot olam legabbeh veitattar bitre nukeve chad illaa vechad tattaa. illaa learka aleh birchan. tattaa leitzena minneh uleitchabbera bahadeh. ubbar nash beveteh taavat givot olam legabbeh veitattar behu.
Kad nafik bearcha lav hachi. imma illaa itchabberat bahadeh vetattaa ishtearat. kad tav leveteh bae leitattera bitre nukeve kidkaamaran. amar rabbi pinchas afillu biklippe sanpore kitra la patche
99: Amar rabbi shimon kegavvna da orayyta kaim ben tere battim, kema dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 8:14) lishne batte yisrael vegomer. chad setima illaa. vechad itgalya yattir. (setima) illaa (da) kol gadol dichtiv, (Devarim Adonai:19) kol gadol velo yasaf.
Vehay kol penimaa ihu dela ishtema vela itgalleya. veda hu kad nevia be garon appik (beh) Adonai bechashay unevia tadir vela pasak. veihu dakka penimaa dela ishtema lealmin.

Umehacha nafka orayyta deihu kol yaakov. vehay ishtema (davar acher deishtema) denafka (davar acher nafka) mehahi dela ishtema. ulevatar itachid dibbur bahadeh venafak levar mecheleh umittakpeh. vekol deyaakov deihu orayyta achid ben tere nikve. achid behay penimaa dela ishtema. veachid behay dilvar deishtema.

Teren innun dela ishtamu uteren innun deishtamu. teren dela ishtamu, da hu chachma illaa setimaa dekayyma bemachashava dela itgalya vela ishtema. levatar nafka veitgalleya zeer bachashay dela ishtema hahu deikre kol gadol dehu dak venafik bachashay.

Teren innun deishtamu, innun denafke mehacha kol deyaakov vedibbur deitachid bahadeh. hay kol gadol deihu bachashay vela ishtema. ihi bayit lachachma illaa. vechol nukeva bayit ikre. vehay dibbur batraa ihu bayit lakkol deyaakov deihu orayyta. veal da orayyta sharya bevet. bet reshit.

Patach veamar bereshit bara elohim, hayeynu dichtiv vayyiven Adonai elohim et hatztzela. et hashshamayim hayeynu dichtiv vayvieha el haadam. veet haaretz kema deat amer veetzem meatzamay. vadday hay ihi eretz hachayyim.

Tu patach rabbi shimon veamar (tehillim 100) neum Adonai ladoni shev limini ad ashit oyvecha hadom leraglecha. neum Adonai ladoni, darga illaa ledarga tattaa kaamar shev limini, leitkashshera maaravit bidromit semala beyamina. begin letabbera chelehon dishar amin ovde kochavim umazzalot. neum Adonai ladoni, neum Adonai da yaakov. laadoni da (Yehoshua 3:11) aron habberit adon kol haaretz.
Davar acher neum Adonai da yovla. laadoni da shemita. dichtiv bah (Shemot 21:5) ahavti et adoni. shev limini deha yemina beyovla sharya. ushemita bae leitkashshera beyamina.

Ta chaze, shemita da la itkeshar bekiyyuma shelim beyamina vvismala miyyoma deishtakkechat, kad baya leitkashshera oshit deroa semala lekovlah uvara alma den. uvegin dehu missitra dismala let beh kiyyuma ad zimna deelef sheviaa. divhahu yoma lechud itkashshar keden beyamina. ucheden tehve ben yamina usemala bekiyyuma shelim veyishtakkechun shamayim chadashim veeretz chadasha ucheden la taade mittamman lealmin.

I hachi bemay nokim shev limini. ella ad zimna yedia dichtiv ad ashit oyvecha hadom leraglecha vela tadir. aval behahu zimna la taade mittamman lealmin dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 54:3) ki yamin usemol tifrotzi lemehve kolla chad.
Ta chaze, et hashshamayim da shechinta illaa. veet haaretz da shechinta diltatta beitchabberuta didchar venukeva kechada. veha ittemar kema deitaru beh chavrayay ad kean.

Bau (davar acher baa) lemezal. kamu. amar rabbi shimon milla hacha gabban. patach rabbi shimon veamar, tere kerae ketive, (Devarim 4:24) ki Adonai elohecha esh ochla hu. uchetiv hatam (Devarim 4:4) veattem haddevekim baAdonai elohechem chayyim kullechem hayyom. hane kerae okimna lehu bechamma atar veitaru behu chavrayay. ta chaze, ki Adonai elohecha esh ochla hu, ha ittemar milla da bego chavrayay deit esha achla esha (vaayteashea) veachil lah veshatze lah. begin deit esha takkifa meesha veukemuha.
Aval ta chaze, man devae leminda chachmeta deyichuda kaddisha. yistakkal beshalhova desalka miggo gachelta. o miggo botzina dedalik. deha shalhova la salka ella
100: Kad itachid bemilla gassa (nusach acher achara).

Ta chaze, beshalhova desalka it teren nehorin. chad nehora chivvra denahir. vechad nehora deitachid bah uchema o tichla. hahu nehora chivvra ihu leela vesalka veorach mishor. utechoteh hahu nehora tichla o uchema deihu karsaya lehahu chivvra.
Vehahu nehora chivvra share ilavveh veitachidu da beda lemehve kolla chad. vehahu nehora uchema o gavavn tichla deihu letatta hu karsaya dikar lehahu chivvavra. veal da raza ditchelta.
Vehay karsaya tichla (o) uchema itachad bemilla ochora leitdalleka dehu mittatta vehahu itar leh leitachada binhora chivvevra (sefer acher illaa).

Veda tichla uchema lezimnin ithadar sumeka. vehahu nehora chivvevra dealeh la ishtanne lealmin deha chivvevra hu tadir. aval hay tichla ishtanne ligvavnin illen. lezimnin tichla o uchema. ulezimnin sumeka.
Vehay itachid litrin sitrin. itachid leela behahu nehora (sefer acher ilaa) chivvevra. itachid letatta behahu milla ditchotoy dimtakna beh leanhara (millin dashevayyn leh leadlaka) uleitachada beh.

Veda achla tadir veshatze lehahu milla deshavyayn leh. deha bechol ma deitdabbak beh letatta vesharya aloy hahu nehora tichla shatze leh veachil leh. begin deorchoy hu leshetzaa ulemeheve achil. deha beh talya shetzu decholla mota decholla. uvegine chach ihi achil kol ma deitdabbak beh letatta.

Vehahu nehora chivvevra desharya aloy la achil vela shatze lealmin vela ishtanne nehoreh. veal da amar moshe ki Adonai elohecha esh ochla hu. ochla vadday. achil veshatze kol ma desharya techotoy. veal da amar Adonai elohecha velo elohenu. begin demoshe behahu nehora chivvevra dilela hava dela shatze vela achil.
Ta chaze, let leh itaruta leitdalleka hay nehora tichla leitachada binhora chivvevra, ella al yede yisrael deinnun mitdabbekan beh techotoy.

Veta chaze, af al gav dearcheh dehay nehora tichla uchema leshetzaa kol ma deitdabbak beh techotoy. yisrael mitdabbekan beh techotoy vekayyman bekiyyuma hada hu dichtiv, (Devarim 4:4) veattem haddevekim baAdonai elohechem chayyim. baAdonai elohechem vela elohenu (ella baAdonai elohechem). behahu nehora tichla uchema deachil veshatze kol ma deitdabbak beh techoteh. veattun mitdabbekan beh vekayyme. dichtiv chayyim kullechem hayyom.

Veal nehora chivvevra, sharyay leela nehora setima deakkif leh. veraza illaa hacha. vecholla tishkach beshalhova desalik vechachmetin deelyonin beh. ata rabbi pinchas uneshakeh. amar berich rachamana deiarana hacha. azlu immeh derabbi pinchas telat milin.

Ahadderu rabbi shimon vechavrayay. amar rabbi shimon ha deamaran raza dechachmeta ihu beyichuda kaddisha. divgin kach hei batraa dishma kaddisha ihu nehora tichla uchema deitachid beyhv dehu nehora chivvevra denahir.

Ta chaze, lezimnin hay nehora tichla 4. ulezimnin Adonai. ella bezimna dela mitdabbekan beh yisrael letatta leadlaka leh leitachada binhora chivvevra, ihu 4. ulezimna demitare leh leitchabbera im nehora chivvevra keden ikre Adonai.

Menalan dichtiv, (Devarim 22:23) ki yihye naara betula, naar ketiv bela Adonai. may tama begin dela itchabberat bidchura. uvechol atar dela ishtakkechu dechar venukeva, hei la ishtechach vesalka mittamman veishtaar 4.

Deha ihi kol zimna deitchabbar binhora chivvevra denahir ikre Adonai. deha keden kolla itchabbar kechada. ihi itdabbekat binhora chivvevra, veyisrael mitdabbekan bah (davar acher 33 letatta) vekayyma techotah leadlaka lah. ucheden kolla chad.
Veda hu raza dekarbana. ditnana desalik atar leh lehay nehora tichla leadlaka. vechad itdelak itchabbar
101: Binhora chivvevra usheragga dalik beyichuda chad.

Uvegin dearcheh dehay nehora tichla leshetzaa ulemehve achil kol ma deitdabbak beh techoteh. kad raava ishtakkach usheragga dalik bechibbura chad keden ketiv, (Melachim 1 18:38) vattippol esh Adonai vattochal et haola vegomer. ucheden ityeyda dehahi sheragga dalik bechibbura chad vekishshura chad. nehora tichla itdabbak binhora chivvevra veihu chad. achil techoteh tarbin veillavvavn. demashma deha la achil (nusach acher veihu veillavavn deha lo achil) techoteh, ella bezimna deihu salik (nusach acher dalik) vecholla itkashshar veitchabbar binhora chivvevra. ucheden shelama dealmin kulhu, vecholla itkashshar beyichuda chad.

Ulevatar desiyyem leshetzaa techoteh hay nehora tichla, mitdabbekan beh techoteh kahane velevae veyisrael. illen bechedva deshir. veillen biruta delibba veillen bitzlota. vesharga dalik alayyhu. veitdabbeku nehorin kechad unehirin almin umitbarchin illain vetattain.

Ucheden veattem haddevekim baAdonai elohechem chayyim kullechem hayyom. veattem, attem mibbae leh. ella 6 leosafa al tarbin veillavvavn deinnun mitdabbekin beh veachlin veshatzan. veattun mitdabbekan beh behahu nehora tichla uchema deachla veattun kayyamin hada hu dichtiv chayyim kullechem hayyom.

(Sefer acher utechelet veargaman), kol gevavnin tavin lechelma, bar mittichla deihu achil veshatze tadir. veihu ilana deveh mota vesharya al alma tattaa. uvegin decholla sharya techoteh ihu achil veshatze.

Vei tema hachi name sharya bishmaya leela vechamma chayyalin innun leela vechulhu (shetzi veachil) kayyme. ta chaze, kol innun dilela behahu nehora tichla itkallelan. aval tattae lav hachi deinnun milla gassa alma (nusach acher achara letatta al ma) dekayyma vesharya aleh. uvegin kach achil veshatze lon. velet lah milla ochora letatta bealma dela ishtetze. begin dinhora tichla shatze lechol ma dekayyma aleh.

Bearbein vechamesh gavvne zine nehorin itpelig alma. shiva mitpallegin leshiva tehomin. kol chad batash bithoma dileh veavanin mitgalgelin bego tehoma. veayil hahu nehora beinnun avanin unekav lon. umaya nafku behu veshakin kol chad vechad al tehoma vechafyay litren sitrin.
Nafku maya beinnun nukevin veal nehora uvatash learba sitre tehoma. mitgalgela nehora bachavertah veiaru bechad ufalgin mayin

Veachidan kol innun shiva beshiva tehome. vecharan (sefer acher sharan) bachashoche tehoma. vechashuche innun itarve behon. vesalkin maya venachatin umitgalgelin beinnun nehorin. veitarvu kechada nehorin vachashochin umayin veitavidu minnayyhu nehorin dela itchazzan chashochan.

Batash kol chad bechavreh. umitpallegin leshivin vechamesh tzinore tehoma uvehu nagdan maya. kol tzinnora vetzinnora salik bekaleh (vaatazeazean) veizdazean tehomin. vechad hahu kala ishtema, kol tehoma kare lechavreh veamar pallig memach veeul bach. hada hu dichtiv, (Tehillim 42:8) tehom el tehom kore lekol tzinnorecha.

Techot illen telat mea (nusach acher veshittin) utemanin (vachamishsha) gidin. minhon chivvevrin minhon uchemin minhon sumekin. itkelilu da beda veitavidu gavvavn chad. innun gidin itrekimu bishva esre reshatot. vechol chad reshet gidin ikre (itkayymu) itrekimu da beda venachatin beshippule tehome. techot illen. teren rishtin kayymin kechezu defarzela. uteren rishtin ochoranin kechezu dinchasha.

Teren karsevavn kayyme alayyhu chad miyyamina vechad missemala. kol innun rishtin mitchabberan kechada umayin nachatin meinnun tzinnorin vealin beillen rishtin. innun tere karsevavn chad kurseyay dirkia uchema, vechad kurseyay dirkia sasgona.
Illen teren karsevavn kad innun salkin salkin (bechad) behahu kurseyay dirkia uchema. vechad nachatin nachatin behahu kurseyay dirkia sasgona.
Illen teren karsevavn chad miyyamina vechad missemala. vehahu kurseyay dirkia uchema miyyamina. vehahu kurseyay dirkia sasgona missemala.
102: Kad salkin bekurseyay dirkia uchema, maich kurseyay dirkia semala venachatin beh.

Mitgalgelin karsevavn chad bechad (sefer acher nachte vanekateyn) naktin kol innun rishtin begavavyyhu vealin lon beshippola dithoma tattaa. kaim chad kurseyay vesalik leela mikkol innun tehome. vekaim kurseyay ochora letatta dechol tehome. ben teren karsevavn illen mitgalgelin kol innun tehome. vechol innun tzinnorin itneatzu ben teren karsevavn illen.
