Shivin vechamesh (davar acher 33 nehorin) tzinnorin innun. shiva innun illae decholla. vechol innun ochoranin achidan behu. vechulhu neitze begalgeloy dehay kurseyay besitra da. uneitzin begalgeloy dehay kurseyay besitra da.

Behon mayin (nusach acher batehavemaya) salkin venachatin. innun denachatin karan bithome uvake lon. innun desalkin illain beinnun nukeve avnin vesalkin umalyayn lishva yammin. ad kan shiva gevavne nehorin beraza illaa.
Shiva nehorin ochoranin mitpallegin leshiva yammim. veyamma chad kalil lon. hahu yamma chad, ihu yamma illaa dechulhu sheva yamin kelilan beh.

Shiva nehorin illen alin lego hahu yamma umachan leh leyamma (leshivin) leshiva sitrin. vechol sitra vesitra itpelag leshiva nachalin. kedichtiv, (Yeshayahu 11:15) vehikkahu (Shemot 242 2) leshiva nechalim vegomer vechol nachala venachala itpelag leshiva neharin. vechol nahara venahara itpelag leshiva archin. vechol orcha veorcha itpelag leshiva shevilin. vechol memoy deyamma kulhon alin legavvavyhu.
Shiva nehorin salkin venachatin leshiva sitrin. shiva nehorin illain alin lego yamma. shitta innun umechad illaa nafke. kema denatil yama hachi palig memoy lechol innun yammin. lechol innun neharin.

Chad tanina letatta bistar semala shaat bechol innun neharin ate bistar kaskesoy kulhon takkifin kefarzela umate leshaava veshaiv atrah. vechol innun nehorin itchashchan kammeh. pumeh velishneh melahata esha (chiddud daleyshenayh) chadud lishnih kecharba takkifa.
Ad demate lemeal lemakdesha go yamma ucheden saiv makdesha veitchashshechan nehorin. unehorin illain salkin min yama. keden yamma mitpalgin memoy bistar semala veyamma kafe vela nagdin memoy.

Veal da raza demilla kema dichtiv vehannachash haya arum mikkol chayyat hassade asher asa Adonai elohim. raza dechivya visha nachit metatta leela (70 meella letatta) vehu shaat al appe mayin meriran. venachit leafte letatta ad deyippelun go rishtoy.
Hay chivya hi mota dealma. vehu al bemeoy desatim devar nash, hu listar semala. veit chivya atra dechayye bistar yamina. tarvavyyhu azle immeh devar nash. kema deukemuha.

Mikkol chayyat hassade deha kol shear chevan dechakla let behu chakkim leavasha kehay. begin deihu zuhama dedahava. vavy leman deitmeshich avatreh. deihu garim leh mota ulechol deatyayn avatreh. veha ukemuha. adam imshich avatreh letatta venachit leminda bechol ma diltatta. kema denachit, hachi itmeshich reuteh vearchoy abbatrayyhu ad dematin lehay chivya vechamu teuveteh dealma veshatu archoy beatar da. keden kam veitmeshich ihu abbatrayyhu deadam veitteteh veitdabbak behu vegarim lehu mota uvechol dare deatu avatreh. ad dematu yisrael letura desinay la pasak zuhama dileh mealma. veha ittemar. kevan dechatu veitdabbeku beilana desharya beh mota letatta. ma ketiv vayyishmeu et kol Adonai elohim mithallech baggan. mehallech en ketiv kan. ella mithallech.

Ta chaze, ad la chata adam, hava salik vekaim bechachma dinhiru illaa. vela hava mitparesh meilana dechayye. kevan deasge tiuveta leminda ulenachata letatta, itmeshach abbatrayyhu, ad deitperash meilana dechayye. veyada ra veshavak tov. veal da ketiv (Tehillim Adonai:Adonai) ki lo el chafetz resha atta lo yegurecha
103: Ra. man deitmeshach batar ra, let leh dira im ilana dechayye.
Vead la chatu havu shamin kala milleela vehavu yade chachmeta illaa vekayyme bekiyyuma dezihara illaa vela dachale. kevan dechatu afillu kala diltatta la have yachlin lemekam beh.

Kegavvna da ad la chavu yisrael beshaata dekayymu yisrael al tura desinay itavar minnayyhu zuhama dehay chivya. deha keden bittul yetzer hara hava mealma vedachu leh minnayyhu. ucheden itachidu beilana dechayye vesalku leela vela nachatu letatta.

Keden havu yadin vechaman ispaklaryan illain veitnaharin enayyhu vechadan leminda ulemishma. ucheden chagar lon kudesha berich hu chagorin deatvavn dishmeh kaddisha dela yechul leshaltaa alayyhu hay chivya vela yesaav lon kekadmita.

Kevan dechatu baegel itavar minnayyhu kol innun dargin unehorin illain. veitabberu minnayyhu innun chagiru mezayynin deitatteru mishma illaa kaddisha. veamshichu alayyhu chivya visha kemilkaddemin vegarmu mota lechol alma. ulevatar ma ketiv (Shemot 33) vayyar aharon vechol bene yisrael et moshe vehinne karan or panav vayyiru miggeshet elav.

Ta chaze, ma ketiv bekadmita (Shemot 14:31) vayyar yisrael et hayyad haggedola vechulhu chaman zaharin illain umitnaharin beispaklarya denahara dichtiv, (Shemot 20:15) vechol haam roim et hakkolot. veal yamma havu chaman vela dachalin dichtiv, (Shemot 15:2) ze eli veanvehu. levatar dechatu, pene hassarsur la havu yachlin lemecheme dichtiv (Shemot la) vayyiru miggeshet elav.

Ta chaze, ma ketiv behu (Shemot 33:6) vayyitnatztzelu bene yisrael et edyam mehar chorev. deitavar minnayyhu innun mezayynan (deitchabbaru behu davar acher daatachegarev behon) betura desinay begin dela yishlot behu hahu chivya visha. kevan deitavar minnayyhu ma ketiv, (Shemot 33:7) umoshe yikkach et haohel venata lo michutz lammachane harechek min hammachane.

Amar rabbi elazar may hay kera legabbe hay. ella kevan deyada moshe deitavaru minnayyhu deyisrael innun zayynin illain, amar ha vadday mikkan ulehala chivya visha yete ledayyra benayyhu, vei yakum makdesha hacha benayyhu, yistaav. miyyad umoshe yikkach et haohel venata lo michutz lammachane harechek min hammachane. begin dechama moshe deha keden yishlot chivya visha ma dela hava mikkadmat dena.

Vekara lo ohel moed, vechi la hava bekadmita ohel moed. ella bekadmita ohel setam, hasheta ohel moed. may moed. rabbi elazar amar letav. verabbi abba amar levish. rabbi elazar amar letav ma moed deihu yom chedva desihara deittosfa beh kedusha (45 moed) la shalta beh pegimuta. uf hacha kara lah bishma da leachazaa deha itrachek (chivya) ohel mibbenayyhu vela itpegim veal da vekara lo ohel moed ketiv.

Verabbi abba amar levish deha bekadmita hava ohel setam kema deat amer, (Yeshayahu 33:20) ohel bal yitzan bal yissa yetedotav lanetzach. vehasheta ohel moed. bekadmita lemehav chayyin arukkin lealmin dela yishlot behu mota. mikkan ulehala ohel moed kema deat amer, (Iyov 30:23) uvet moed lechol chay. hasheta ityeyhiv beh zimna vechayyin ketzuvin lealma. bekadmita la itpegim, vehasheta itpegim. bekadmita chavruta veziuuga desihara beshimsha dela yaadun. hasheta ohel moed ziuuga dilhon mizman lizman. uvegine chach vekara lo ohel moed ma dela hava kodem.

Rabbi shimon hava yativ lelya chad velae beorayyta. vehavu yatve kammeh rabbi yehuda verabbi yitzchak verabbi yose. amar rabbi yehuda ha ketiv, (Shemot 33:6) vayyitnatztzelu bene yisrael et edyam mehar chorev, vekaamrinan degarmu mota alayyhu mehahu zimna uleela, veshallit behu hahu chivya visha deaadu leh minnayyhu bekadmita. yisrael tenach. yehoshua dela chata, aade (davar acher itade) minneh hahu zayyna illaa dekabbil immehon betura desinay o la.
104: I tema dela aade (davar acher itade) minneh, i hachi ammay mit kishar bene nasha. i tema deitadde minneh, ammay. veha la chata. deha ihu im moshe hava beshaata dechavu yisrael. vei tema (davar acher 33 deha) dela kabbil hahu itra betura desinay kema dekabbilu yisrael, ammay.

Patach veamar, (Tehillim 11:7) ki tzaddik Adonai tzedakot ahev yashar yechozu fanemo. hay kera amru beh chavrayay may dekaamru. aval ki tzaddik Adonai, tzaddik hu ushemeh tzaddik, uvegine chach tzedakot ahev.

Yashar, ihu yashar. kema deat amer tzaddik veyashar. veal da yechozu fanemo kol bene alma vitaknu archayyhu lemehach beorach meshar kedka yaut. ta chaze, kad dain kudesha berich hu alma la dan leh ella lefum rubban divne nasha.

Veta chaze, kad chav adam beilana deachal minneh, geram lehahu ilana deshare beh mota lechol alma. vegarim pegimu leafrasha itteta mibbaalah. vekaim chova difgimu da besihara ad dekayymu yisrael betura desinay. kevan dekayymu yisrael betura desinay itavar hahu pegimu desihara vekayyma leanhara tadir.

Kevan dechavu yisrael baegla, tavat kemilkaddemin sihara leitpagma. veshalta chivya visha veachid bah umashich lah legabbeh. vechad yada moshe dechavu yisrael veitavar minayyhu innun zayynin kaddishin illain, yada vadday deha chivya achid beh besihara leamshacha lah legabbeh veitpegimat. keden appik lah levar.

Vechevan dekayyma leitpagma af al gav dihoshua kaim beitra dezayynin dileh, kevan dippegime sharya bah veithadderat kema deitpegimat bechova deadam, la yachil bar nash leitkayyma. bar moshe dehava shallit bah umoteh hava besitra ochora illaa. veal da la hava reshu vah lekayyma lihoshua tadir vela leochora. veal kach ohel moed kare leh. ohel deha sharya beh zeman katziv lechol alma.
Veal da raza demila, it yamina leela veit yamina letatta. it semala leela veit semala letatta. it yamina leela bikdushsha illaa. veit yamina letatta deihu besitra ochora.

It semala leela bikdushsha illaa leatara rechimuta leitkashshera sihara beatar kaddisha leela leitnahara. veit semala letatta deafrish rechimuta dilela veafrish lah milleanhara beshimsha uleitkerava bahadeh. veda hu sitra dechivya visha.

Dechad semala da diltatta itarat keden mashich lah lesihara veafrish lah milleela veitchashchat nehoraa veitdabbekat bechivya visha. ucheden sheivat mota letatta lecholla veitdabbekat bechivya veitrachkat meilana dechayyay.

Veal da garim mota lechol alma. veda hu dichden isteavat makdesha ad zeman katziv deatkanat sihara vetavat leanhara veda hu ohel moed. veal da yehoshua la mit ella beita shel nachash da dekariv ufegim mashkena kidkadmita.

Veda hu raza dichtiv, (Shemot 33:11) vihoshu bin nun naar lo yamish mittoch haohel. deaf al gav deihu naar letatta lekabbela nehora, lo yamish mittoch haohel. kema deitpegim da hachi name itpegim da. af al gav dezayyna kaddisha hava leh. kevan deitpegim sihara hachi hu vadday la ishteziv bilchodoy minneh mehahu gavvna mammash.

Ta chaze, kegavvna da kevan dechav adam natal kudesha berich hu minneh innun zayyne atvavn nehirin kaddishin deatar leh kudesha berich hu. ucheden dachalu veyadu deha itpashtu minnayyhu hada hu dichtiv vayyedu ke erumim hem. bekadmita havu mitlabbeshan beinnun kitre yekar mezayynin deinnun cheru mikkolla. kevan dechavu itpashtu minnayyhu. ucheden yada deha mota kare lon. veyadu deitpeshitu mecheru decholla. vegarmu mota lon ulechol alma,
105: Vayitperu ale teena ha (36 2) okimna deolifu kol zayyni charshin vekosmin vaachidu behay diltatta kema deittemar. vehahi shaata itgera zekifu vekoma deadam mea ammin. ucheden itavid piruda vekaim adam bedina veitlatya ara veha okimna:

Vaygaresh et haadam. amar rabbi elazar la yedana man avid teruchin leman. i kudesha berich hu avad teruchin leadam i la. aval milla ithappich vaygaresh et, et dayyka. uman gerash et, haadam. haadam vadday gerash et.

Uvegin da ketiv vayshallechehu Adonai elohim miggan eden. ammay vayshallechehu, begin degerash adam et kidkaamaran. vayyashken, ihu ashre lon beatar da deihu garim vesatim orchin ushevilin veashre dinin al alma veamshich levavtin mehahu yoma uleela.

Veet lahat hacherev hammithappechet, kol innun desharyayn bekozfe dinin al alma, demithappechin ligvavnin saggiin begin leitperaa mealma. lezimnin guverin lezimnin nashin lezimnin esha melahata ulezimnin ruchin delet man dekaim behu. vechol da lishmor et derech etz hachayyim dela yosifun leavasha kekadmita.

Lahat hacherev, innun dimlahatan esha vekostiri al rashehon derashshiaya vechayyayvaya. umithappechin gevavnin lechamma zayynin lefum archayyhu divni nasha. veal da lahat kema deat amer (Malachi 3:19) velihet otam hayyom habba vegomer veha ittemar. hacherev da cherev laAdonai kema deat amer, (yeshaya la) cherev laAdonai melea dam vegomer.
Amar rabbi yehuda lahat hacherev (afillu) kol innun kasterin diltatta demithappechin middeyokna lidyokana kulhon memannan al alma leavasha uleastaa lon lechayyayve alma deavrin al pikkude demarehon.

Ta chaze, kevan dechav adam amshich aleh kamma zayynin bishin vechamma gardini nimmusin vedachil mikkulhu vela yachil lekayyma alayyhu. shelomo yada chachmeta illaa veshavve leh kudesha berich hu itra demalchuta vehavu dachalu minneh kol alma. kevan dechav amshich aleh kamma zayynin bishin vechamma gardine nimmusin vedachil mikkulhu ucheden yachilu leavasha leh uma dehava bideh netalu minneh.
Veal da bemma deazil bar nash uvehahu archa deitdabbak beh, hachi mashich aleh chela memanna deazil lekovleh. kach adam hava mashich aleh chela ochora mesaav. desaiv leh ulechol bene alma.

Ta chaze, kad chav adam mashich aleh chela mesaava vesaiv leh ulechol bene alma. vehay hu chivya visha deihu mesaav vesaiv alma. detaninan kad appik nishmatin mibbeni nesha, ishtaar minneh gufa mesaav vesaiv beta. vesaiv lechol innun dimkarvin beh. hada hu dichtiv, (Bamidbar 19:11) hannogea bemet vegomer.

Veal da kevan deihu natil nishmeta vesaiv gufa keden ityeyhiv reshu lechol innun sitre mesaavan lesharya aloy. deha hahu gufa istaav missitra dehahu chivya visha desharya aloy. veal da bechol atar dehahu chivya visha share mesaav leh veistaav.

Veta chaze, kol bene alma beshaata denayyme al arsayyhu belelya, velelya paris gadfaha al kol bene alma taame taama demota. umiggo detaame taama demota hay rucha mesaava shatya al alma vesaiv (al) alma (davar acher 33 bego kiftera dileh) vesharya al yedoy devar nash veistaav.

Vechad itar veithaddar leh nishmateh, bechol ma deyikrav bidoy kulhu mesaave, begin desharya alayyhu ruach mesoova. veal da la yissav bar nash manoy lealbasha mimman dela natil yedoy. deha amshich aleh hahu ruach mesaava veistaav. veit leh reshu lehay ruach mesaava lesharya bechol atar deishtechach reshimu missitreh.
Veal da la yittol yedoy bar nash mimman dela natil yedoy begin deamshich aleh hahu ruach mesoova vekabbil leh hay denatal maya minneh veit leh reshu lesharya aloy
106: Devar nash. begin kach bae bar nash leistammera bechol sitroy missitra dehay chivya visha dela yishlot aloy. vezammin kudesha berich hu lealma deate leaavara leh mealma. hada hu dichtiv, (Zecharya 13:2) veet ruach hattumea aavir min haaretz (ucheden) (davar acher uchetiv) (yeshaya 22) bila hammavet lanetzach vegomer:

Vehaadam yada et chavva ishto vegomer. rabbi abba patach (veamar) (Kohelet 3:21) mi yodea ruach beni haadam haola hi lemala veruach habbehema hayyoredet hi lematta laaretz. hay kera kamma gevavnin it beh. vehachi hu kol milloy deorayyta kamma gevavnin bechol chad vechad vechulhu yaut vehachi innun.

Vechol orayyta mitparsha beshivin anpin. lokovel shivin sitrin veshivin anpin. vehachi hu bechol milla umilla deorayyta. vechol may denafik mikkol milla umilla kamma gevavnin itparshan minneh lechol sitrin.

Ta chaze, kad bar nash azil beorach keshot, hu azil limina, veamshich aleh rucha kaddisha illaa meela. vehay ruach salik biruta kaddisha leitachada leela uleitdabbeka bikdusha illaa dela itadde minneh.

Vechad bar nash azil beorach bish vesate archoy, hu amshich aleh ruach mesoova delistar semala, vesaiv leh veistaav beh. kema deat amer, (Vayikra 11:43) velo tittamu bahem venitmetem bam. ata leistaava mesaavin leh.

Veta chaze, beshaata devar nash azil beorach keshot veamshich aleh rucha kaddisha illaa veitdabbik beh, bera deyolid veyippuk minneh lealma, hu mashich aleh kedusha illaa, vihe kaddish bikdusha demareh. kema dichtiv, (Vayikra 20:7) vehitkaddishtem vihyitem kedoshim vegomer.
Vechad ihu azil bistar semala, veamshich aleh ruach mesaava veitdevak beh, bera deyippuk minneh lealma hu amshich aleh ruach mesaavu veyistaav bimsaavu dehahu sitra.

Veal da ketiv mi yodea ruach beni haadam haola hi lemala. kad ihu beitdabbekut yamina salka hi leela. vechad ihu beitdabbekut semala hahu setar semala deihu ruach mesaavu nachit meela letatta veshavve diyyureh bevar nash vela aade minneh. uvera (uma) deolid behahu (ruach) mesaavu ihu have bereh mehahu ruach mesaav ihu hahu bera.

Adam itdabbak behahu ruach mesaav veitteteh itdabbeka beh bekadmita venatlat vekabbilat hahu zuhama minneh olid bar. hay bera bera deruach mesaava ihu. veal da teren benin havu. chad mehahu ruach mesaav vechad kad tav adam bityuveta. uvegine chach hay missitra mesoova. (veda davar acher vehay) missitra dachyay.

Rabbi elazar amar beshaata deattil nachash hahu zuhama bah bechavva kabbilat leh. vechad ishtammash immah adam olidat teren benin. chad mehahu sitra mesoova vechad missitra deadam. vehave dame hevel bediukena dilela vekayyin bediukena diltatta. uvegin kach itperashu archayyhu da min da.

Vadday kayin bera deruach mesoova hava deihu chivya visha. (vehevel bara deadam) hava. uvegin dekayin ata missitra demalach hammavet katil leh leachuy. vehu besitra dileh. uminneh kol medorin bishin umazikin veshedin veruchin atyayn lealma.

Amar rabbi yose, kayin, kina dimdorin bishin deatu missitra dimsoova lealma. ulevatar ayytiu karbana. da akriv missitra dileh veda akriv missitra dileh. hada hu dichtiv vayhi mikketz yamim vayyave kayin mipperi haadama vegomer. rabbi shimon amar vayhi mikketz yamim, may mikketz yamim, da hu ketz kol basar. uman ihu da malach hammavet.

Vekayin mehahu ketz yamim ayyte karbana. dayyka dekaamar mikketz yamim vela amar mikketz yamin. uvegin kach katuv bedaniyyel (Daniel 12:13) veatta lech lakketz vetanuach vetaamod legoralcha. amar leh leketz hayyamim o leketz hayyamin. amar leh leketz hayyamin. vekayin mikketz hayyamim ayyte,
107: Vayyave kayin mipperi haadama. kema deat amer umipperi haetz. amar rabbi elazar mipperi haadama kema deat amer, (Yeshayahu 3:11) oy larasha ra ki gemul yadav vegomer. (ki peri maallehem yochlu. peri maallehem yochlu da malach hammavet yochlu) (nusach acher gemul yadav da malach hammavet. yaase lo deitmeshach) alayyhu veyitdabbak behu lekatla lon ulesoova lon. veal da kayin akriv missitra dileh.

Vehevel hevi gam hu mibbechorot leasgaa sitra illaa deatya missetar kedushata (davar acher missitra kaddisha). uvegine chach vayyishsha Adonai el hevel veel minchato veel kayin veel minchato lo shaa. la kabbil (lon) (davar acher leh) kudesha berich hu. veal da vayyichar lekayin meod. vayyippelu fanav deha la itkabbilu anpoy, innun anpin desitroy vekabbil leh lehevel.

Uvegine chach katuv vayhi bihyotam bassade. bassade da itteta. kema deat amer (Devarim 22:27) ki bassade metzaah, vekayin kane al nukeva yetera deityelidat im hevel dichtiv vattosef laledet veha ittemar:

Halo im tetiv seet kema deittemar. aval seet kedamar rabbi abba seet tistallak leela vela techot letatta. amar rabbi yose hay milla hasheta ittemar veyaut hu. aval hachi shemana seet yesallak minach veyishbok lach itdabbekuta da deruach mesaava.

Vei la lappetach chattat rovetz. may lappetach da dina illaa deihu pitcha decholla kema deat amer (Tehillim 118:19) pitchu li shaare tzedek. chattat rovetz hahu sitra deitdabbekat beh veitmashchat alach yehe natir lach leitperaa minnach ketarguma.

Amar rabbi yitzchak, ta chaze, beshaata dekatil kayin lehevel, la hava yada hech (nafik) (davar acher yafik) nishmateh minneh. vehava nashich leh beshineh kechivya. veha ukemuha chavraya. beh shaata layyt leh kudesha berich hu. vehava azil lechol sitre alma, vela hava atar dimkabbel leh. ad deatfach al resheh vetav kamme mareh. vekabbilat leh ara bemadora letatta.

Rabbi yose amar ara kabbilat leh lemehach bah dichtiv vayyasem Adonai lekayin ot. rabbi yitzchak amar lav hachi. ella letatta kabbilat leh ara bemadora chada ditchotah dichtiv hen gerashta oti hayyom meal pene haadama. meal pene haadama gorash. aval letatta la gorash.

Uvean atar kabbilat leh ara, bearka. vechol innun dedayyre tamman alehon ketiv (Yirmeyahu 10:11) yevadu meara umittechot shemaya elle. vetamman shavve medoreh. vehayeynu dichtiv vayyeshev beeretz nod kidmat eden.

Tosefta kevan deamar kayin gadol avoni minso, machal leh kudesha bericha hu palgu meonsheh. begin degazar aleh bekadmitta vamar leh na vanad tihye vaaretz vehasheta ishtaar benod bilchodoy. hada hu dichtiv vyyetztze kayin millippene 5, vego; kelomar dechad nappak min kadam hhava begin lemehevi nad beara vla na.

Vod amru kad nappak kayin min kadam hamar lo adam beri ma itteavid al dinacha. amar lo kayin abba kevar ittebasritt dimchal li kudesha bericha hu benod bilchodoy. amar lo heacha hu. amar lo begin detavitt veoditt kammeh. amar adam vchi den hu rav vetakkif chela ditteshuva veana la yadiatt. shera leshabbecha lemareh uleodaa leh pattach vamar, (Tehillim 92:1-2) mizmor shir leyom hashabbatt tov lehodott la; kelomar tov leshabbacha vlattava uleodaa kammeh kudesha bericha hu. (74 kan tosefta)
Veamar rabbi yitzchak mehahi shaata dekatil kayin lehevel, deitperash (davar acher itperash) adam meitteteh. teren ruchin nukevin havu atyayn umizdavgan immeh, veolid ruchin veshedin deshatan bealma.

Vela tikshe lach hay. deha bar nash kad ihu bechelmeh atyayn ruchin nukevin vechayychan immeh umitchammeman minneh veolidin levatar. veillen ikrun nige bene adam. vela mithappechan ella lidyokne bene nasha. velet lon saarin beresha. veal da ketiv bishlomo (Shmuel 2 7:14) vehochachtiv beshevet anashim uvenige bene adam. veafillu kehay gavvna ruchin dechurin atyayn linshe alma umitabberan minnayyhu veolidan ruchin. vechulhon nige bene adam ikrun.
Batar mea utelatin shenin itlabbash adam
108: Bekinuya veitchabbar beitteteh veolid bar ukera shemeh shet. raza desofa deatvavn bekitre gelifan. rabbi yehuda amar raza derucha deitavid deitlabbash begufa (deara) ochora bealma hada hu dichtiv ki shat li elohim zera acher tachat hevel.

Veamar rabbi yehuda ketiv vayyoled bidmuto (80 72 9) ketzalmo mashma divnin ochoranin la havu (bidmuto ketztzalmo umilla da hu) bediukena dileh. veda bidmuto ketzalmo betikuna degufa uvetikuna denafsha beorach meshar. (nusach acher umilla da hu kema deittemar. veamar rabbi abba mishshemeh derabbi yesa) kema deamar rabbi shimon mishmeh derav yeva sava benin ochoranin beitdabbekuta dezuhama denachash vehahu derachiv beh deihu samael havu. uvegine chach la hava bediukena deadam. vei tema ha amart dehevel missitra ochora hava. hachi hu. aval tarvavyyhu la havu bediukena diltatta.

Amar (davar acher leh) rabbi yose veha ketiv vehaadam yada et chavva ishto vattahar vatteled et kayin. vela (davar acher amar leh hachi hu. aval tarevaveyhev lo havo bediukeneh. dela) ketiv vayyoled et kayin. veafillu behevel la ketiv vayyoled ella vattosef laledet et achiv et havel. veda hu raza demilla. aval behay ma ketiv, vayyoled bidmuto ketzalmo.

Rabbi shimon amar mea utelatin shenin itperash adam meitteteh. vechol innun mea utelatin shenin hava olid ruchin veshedin bealma. begin hahu chela dezuhama dehava shaiv beh. kevan dechasil minneh hahu zuhama, tav vekanni (deade) leinteteh veolid bar. keden ketiv vayyoled bidmuto ketzalmo.

Ta chaze, kol bar nash deazil listar semala vesaiv archoy, kol ruche mesaave mashich al garmeh veruach mesaav itdabbak beh vela aade minneh. veitdabbekuta (dileh) dehahu rucha mesaav have vehay bar nash vela beochora. uvegine chach itdabbekuta dilhon lav ihu ella beinnun demitdabbekin behu. zakkain innun tzaddikaya deazle beorach meshar veinnun zakkae keshot uvenehon zakkain bealma vealayyhu ketiv, (Mishlei 2:21) ki yesharim yishkenu aretz.

Amar rabbi chiyyay may dichtiv vaachot tuval kayin naama. may irya hacha dekaamar kera dishmah naama. ela begin detaayayn bene nasha avatrah veafillu ruchin veshedin. rabbi yitzchak amar innun bene haelohim azza vaazael tau batrah.

Rabbi shimon amar imman shel shedim havat. demissitra dekayin nafkat. vehi itmannat al lelya (im lilit) beaskera deravye. amar leh rabbi abba veha amar mar dehi itmannat lechayycha bivni nasha. amar leh hachi hu vadday deha ihi atyayt vechayychat behu bivne nasha, ulezimnin deolidat ruchin bealma minnayyhu vead kan ihi kayymat lechayycha behu bivni nasha.

Amar leh rabbi abba veha innun metin (130 1) kivne nasha, may tama ihi kayymat ad hasheta. amar leh hachi hu. aval lilit venaama veagrat bat machalat denafkat missitra dilhon kulhu kayyaymot ad divaer kudesha berich hu, ruach mesoova mealma dichtiv (Zecharya 13:2) veet ruach hattuma aavir min haaretz.

Amar rabbi shimon vavy lon livne nasha innun dela yadin vela mashgichin vela mistakkelin vechulhu atimin dela yadin kamma malyay alma mibbiryayn meshanyayn dela itchazun umimilin setimin. deilmale (yahiv) ityeyhav reshu leena lemecheze, yitmehun bene nesha hech yachlin leitkayyma bealma.

Ta chaze, hay naama imma deshedin havat. umissitrah atyayn kol innun shedin demitchammeman mibbeni nasha venatle ruach tiuveta minnayyhu vechayychat behon deavde lon baale keryayn. uvegin devaal keri ate missitra deruach mesoova, bae leaschaa garmeh leitdakkaa minneh. veha ukemuha chavraya:

Ze sefer toldot adam lidyokni. amar rabbi yitzchak achme kudesha berich hu leadam deyokne dechol innun darin deyetun lealma. vechol chakkime alma umalche alma dizminin lekayyma alayyhu deyisrael. (24) mata lemecheme david malka deyisrael deityeylid umit. amar leh (davar acher 33 amar vakev) (140 1, 168 1) mishshenin dili (osif) ozif leh 70 shenin. vegaru meadam 70 shenin vesalik lon kudesha berich hu ledavid.
Veal da shabbach david veamar (Tehillim 92:5) ki simmachtani
109: Adonai befoolecha bemaase yadecha arannen. man garam li chedva (behay) bealma, poolecha da hu adam kadmaa deihu poolo dekudesha berich hu, vela poolo devasar vadam. maase yadav dekudesha berich hu vela mibbene nasha. veal da gari innun shivin shenin meadam, meelef shenin dehava leh leitkayyma behu.

Veachme leh kudesha berich hu kol chakkime dara vedara. ad demata ledareh derabbi akiva. vechame orayyta dideh vechade. chame mitateh veatziv. patach veamar (Tehillim 139:17) veli ma yakru reecha el me atzmu rashehem:

Ze sefer, sefer vadday. veha (leel 37 2) okimna dechad hava adam beginta deeden nachit leh kudesha berich hu sifra al yeda deraziel malacha kaddisha memanna al raze illain kaddishin uveh gelifin gillufe illain vechachma kaddisha. veshivin uteren zine dechachmeta havu mitparshan minneh leshit mea veshivin gelifin deraze illae.

Beemtzaita desafra gelifa dechachmeta leminda elef vechamesh mea maftechan dela itmasseran leillae kaddishe. vechulhu istimu beh besafra ad demata (davar acher leh laadam, kevan demata) legabbe deadam, (minneh) havu mitkanneshe malache illae leminda ulemishma. vehavu amre (Tehillim 57:6) ruma al hashshamayim elohim al kol haaretz kevodecha.

Ba shaata itremiz legabbeh haderaneyal malacha kaddisha veamar leh, adam, adam, hve ganiz yekara demarach dela ityeyhiv reshuta leillae leminda bikara demarach bar ant. vehava immeh tamir veganiz hahu sifra ad denafak adam migginta deeden.

Deha bekadmita hava meayyen beh umishtamesh kol yoma beginzaya demareh veitgalyayn leh razin illain ma dela yadu shammashe illain. kevan dechata veavar al pikkuda demareh parach hahu sifra minnih. vehava adam tofeach al reshoy uvache veal beme gichon ad kadleh umaya avdin gufeh chaladin chaladin veishtanne ziyivih.

Beshaata hahi ramaz kudesha berich hu lirfael veativ leh hahu sifra uveh hava mishtaddel adam veanach leh leshet bereh vechen lechol innun toldot ad demata leavraham uveh hava yada leistakkala bikara demareh veha ittemar. vechen lechanoch ityeyhav leh sifra veistakkal minneh bikara illaa:
Zachar unekeva beraam. rabbi shimon amar razin illain itgalleyayn behani tere kerae. zachar unekeva beraam, leminda yekara illaa raza dimhemanuta demiggo raza dena itbere adam.

Ta chaze beraza deitberiu shamayim vaaretz itbere adam. behu ketiv elle toldot hashshamayim vehaaretz (behibbaram). beadam ketiv ze sefer toldot adam. behu ketiv behibbaram. beadam ketiv beyom hibbaram.
Zachar unekeva beraam. mehacha (olifna) kol diukena dela ishtechach beh dechar venukeva lav ihu diukena illaa kedka chaze. uveraza dematnitin okimna.

Ta chaze, bechol atar dela ishtakkechu dechar venukeva kechada kudesha berich hu la shavi medoreh behahu atar. uvirchan la ishtakkachu ella beatar deishtechach dechar venukeva. dichtiv vayvarech otam vayyikra et shemam adam beyom hibbaram. vela ketiv vayvarech oto vayyikra et shemo adam. deafillu adam la ikre ella dechar venukeva kechada.

Rabbi yehuda amar miyyoma deitcharav be makdesha birchan la ishtakkechu bealma veitavidu bechol yoma. dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 57:1) hatztzaddik avad. may avad, avad birchan dehavu sharyayn beh kema dichtiv, (Mishlei 10:6) berachot lerosh tzaddik. uchetiv, (Yirmeyahu 7:28) avda haemuna. kegavvna da ketiv vayvarech otam uchetiv vayvarech otam elohim. mishshet ityaychasu kol dare alma vechol innun tzaddike keshot dehavu bealma.
Amar rabbi yose illen atvavn batrain dehavu beorayyta (leishtakkecha) ishtakkachu batar daavar adam al atvavn deorayyta kulhu (beseder 1000. uvegin kach kera lehahu bara deihu kademavetav
110: Betzalmo 700 deinnun kiyyuma deatvavn). uvityuveteh (sefer acher vabetayavebateyh) lekamme mareh achid beillen teren. umikkeden ithadderu atvavn lemafrea beseder 1000.

Uvegin da kara lehahu bera deityelid leh deihu bidmuto ketzalmo shet deinnun siyyuma deatvavn. vela ittakkanu atvavn ad dekayymu yisrael al tura desinay. ucheden ahadderu atvavn al tikkunayyhu keyoma deitberiu shamayim vaaretz. veitbassam alma vekayma al kiyyumeh.

Rabbi abba amar yoma deavar adam al pikkuda demareh, bayayn shamayim vaaretz (laatagepaa) leitakkara meatrayyhu. may tama begin deinnun la kayymu ella al berit dichtiv (Yirmeyahu 33:25) im lo veriti yomam valayla chukkot shamayim vaaretz lo samti. veadam avar berit shenneemar (Hoshea 6:7) vehemma cheadam avru berit.

Veilmale degale kamme kudesha berich hu dizminin yisrael lekayyma al tura desinay lekayyma hay berit, la itkeyyaym alma (din). rabbi chizkiyya amar kol man deode al cheteh, kudesha berich hu shavik leh umachil al choveh.

Ta chaze, kad bara kudesha berich hu alma, avad hay berit vekayyma aleh alma. menalan dichtiv (Bereshit) bara shit, da berit dealma kayma aleh. shit deminneh negidin venafka birchan lealma vealeh itbere alma. veadam avar al hay berit veaavar leh meatreh (sefer acher meammeha).

Hay berit itremizat beat yod at zeera ikkera visoda dealma. kad olid bar, ode al cheto vekara shemeh 700. vela adkar beh yod lemeheve shit, begin deavar aleh. uvegin kach kudesha berich hu (mehacha) minneh ishtil alma veityaychasu kol dare zakkaa dealma (mishshet).

Veta chaze, kad kayymu yisrael al tura desinay, al ben teren atvavn illen raza divrit. uman ihu vet. veal ben teren atvavn deishtearu veyahiv leh leyisrael. vechad al 412 raza divrit ben teren atvavn illen deinnun 360 416 (alu) veitavidu shabbat. kema deat amer, (Shemot 31:16) veshamru bene yisrael et hashshabbat laasot et hashshabbat ledorotam berit olam. kema dehava sheruta dealma leityaychasu behu kol dare alma meillen teren atvavn 700 havu talyayn ad deishtachlal alma kedka yaut veal benayyhu berit kaddisha veishtachlal bishlimu veitavidu shabbat.
Amar rabbi yose illen teren atvavn ishtachlelu beat bet vechad (ithaddar atvavn lemafrea min yoma deityeylid shet ahadru atvavn bechol dara vedara ad demate yisrael letura desinay veittekanu.)

Amar rabbi yehuda letatta ithadderu. uvechol dara vedara hava gafif alma beatvavn vela mityashvin beduchetayyhu. kad ityayhavat orayyta leyisrael ittakkan kolla (nusach acher atvavn kullehu ittekanu) (kan shayych maamar besitre otiyyot bazzohar chodesh daf 10, vabedapevas vaynaytzayah daf 13 2 vaychi adam kulei 370) rabbi elazar omer beyome enosh havu chakkimin beni nasha bechachma decharshin vekosmin uvechachmata lemeetzar lechele dishmaya. vela hava bar nash miyyoma denafak adam migginta deeden veappik imeh chachmeta detarpe ilana deishtaddal bah. deha adam veitteteh veinnun denafku minneh ad deata enosh, sheviku lah.

Kad ata enosh chama lon vechama chachmathon meshanyayn (sefer acher mashetayyn) illain. veishtaddelu behon veavdin (bah) avidtin vecharshin vekosmin veolifu minhon ad deitpashtat hahi chachmeta bedara demabbul. vechulhu havu avde avidtayyhu leavasha.

Vehavu mittakfe legabbe noach beinnun chachmetan. veamre dela yachil dina dealma leashraa alayyhu, deha innun avde chachmeta ledachyay lechol innun mare dedina. umeenosh shariu kulhu leishtaddelu beillen chachmetan hada hu dichtiv az huchal likro beshem Adonai.

Rabbi yitzchak amar kol innun zakkain dehavu behu levatar behahu dara, kulhu havu mishtaddele lemachaa behu (naabageyn dela itanashu alayhu) kemo yered metushelach vechanoch. vela yachilu. ad deitpashtu chayyayvin marde bemarehon veamre (Iyov 21:15) ma shadday ki naavdennu.
Vechi hay tippeshuta havu ka amre. ella begin dehavu yade kol innun chachmetan vechulhu memannan dealma deitpakkedan alayyhu vehavu merachatzan behu. ad deativ kudesha berich hu alma kedka hava. deha
111: Bekadmita hava mayim bemayim. ulevatar ativ leh lealma kidkadmita. vela itchariv mikkola. deha berachamin ashgach alayyhu. dichtiv, (Tehillim 29:10) Adonai lammabbul yashav. vela ketiv elohim.

Beyomoy deenosh afillu yenuke dehahu (yoma) dara kulhu havu mashgechan bechachmatan illain vehave mistakkelan behu. amar rabbi yesa i hachi tippeshin havu dela havu yadin dezammin kudesha berich hu leayytaa alayyhu me tofana vimutun behu.

Amar rabbi yitzchak minda yade. aval achidu tippeshuta belibbayyhu. deinnun havu yade hahu malacha dimmanna al esha vehahu dimmanna al maya vehavu yadin lemeetzar lon dela yachlin lemebad dina alayyhu. veinnun la havu yade dekudesha berich hu shalit al ara uminneh yete dina al alma.

Ela havu chaman dealma itpakkad bida deinnun memannan uvehu kol mille alma. uvegine kach la havu mistakkelan beh bekudesha berich hu vela mashgichin beavidteh. ad deara itchabbalat. veruach kudesha achriz bechol yoma veamar (Tehillim 104:35) yittammu chattaim min haaretz ureshaim od enam.

Veorich kudesha berich hu lon kol hahu zimna deinnun zakkain yered umetushelach vechanoch kayymin bealma. kevan deistallaku mealma, ucheden anchit kudesha berich hu dina alayyhu veitavidu kema deat amer, (Bereshit 7:23) vayyimmachu min haaretz (kan shayych maamar 17 daf 66 vabedapevas vaneytzeyah 42 1 370):

Vayyithallecha chanoch et haelohim veenennu ki lakach oto elohim. rabbi yose patach (Shir HaShirim 1:12) ad shehammelech bimsibbo nirdi natan recho. hay kera ittemar. avalotta chaze, kach archoy dekudesha berich hu. beshata devar nash itdabbak beh vehu ashre diyyureh aleh. veyada dilvatar yomin yisrach. akdim velakit recheh tav minneh vesalik leh mealma.

Hada hu dichtiv ad shehammelech bimsibbo nirdi natan recho. ad shehammelech da kudesha berich hu. bimsibbo da hahu bar nash deitdabbak beh veazil bearchoy. nirdi natan recho, innun ovadin tavin deveh divginhon yistallak mealma ad dela mata zimneh.

Veal da hava shelomo malka amar (Kohelet 8:14) yesh hevel asher naasa al haaretz asher yesh tzaddikim vegomer. yesh tzaddikim asher maggia alehem kemaase harshaim, kema deokimna divgin deovadehon tavin kudesha berich hu salik lon mealma (begin dela yserachev 1. umiggo rechimuta behu mesullak lehon) ad la mata zimnayyhu. veavid behon dinin. veyesh reshaim asher maggia alehem kemaase hatztzaddikim dekudesha berich hu orich lon yomin veorich rugezeh behu. vechol da kema deittemar. illen begin dela yisrechun. veillen begin delihadderu legabbeh. o begin deyippuk minnayyhu benin demaale.

Ta chaze chanoch zakkaa hava. vekudesha berich hu chama leh deyisrach levatar. velakit leh ad la yisrach. hada hu dichtiv, (Shir HaShirim 6:2) velilkot shoshannim. begin deyahave recha tav lakit lon kudesha berich hu ad la yisrechu. veennnu ki lakach oto elohim. veenennu, learcha yomin kishar beni nasha dehavu orche yomin. may tama begin delakach leh kudesha berich hu ad la mate zimneh.

Rabbi elazar amar chanoch natil leh kudesha berich hu meara veaskeh lishme meromim veamsar bideh kol ginze illain (leel 37 2) um maftechan satre gelifin debhu mishtammeshe malache illae vechulhu itmesaru bideh. veha okimna:

Vayyar Adonai ki rabba raat haadam baaretz vechol yetzer machshevot libbo. rabbi yehuda patach (Tehillim Adonai:Adonai) ki lo el chafetz resha atta lo yegurecha ra. hay kera ittemar veukemuha. avalotta chaze, man deitdabbak beyetzer hara veitmashich avatreh veyistaav hu visaavun leh kema deittemar.

Ki rabba raat haadam, kol bishin havu avde, vela ishtelim chovayyhu ad dehavu oshdin damin lemaggana al ara. uman innun dehavu mechabbelin archayyhu al ara. hada hu dichtiv rak ra kol hayyom. ketiv hacha rak ra
112: Uchetiv hatam (lo yegurecha ra, uchetiv) (Bereshit 38:7) vayhi er bechor yehuda ra beeni Adonai.

Amar rabbi yose vechi ra lav ihu rasha. amar leh, la. rasha afillu arim yedeh legabbe chavreh, af al gav dela avid leh midi ikre rasha. kema dichtiv, (Shemot 2:13) vayyomer larasha lamma takke reecha. hikkita la ketiv ella takke.

Aval ra lo ikre ella man dimchabbel archeh vesaiv garmeh vesaiv ara veyahiv chela vetukepa leruach mesoova deikre ra dichtiv rak ra kol hayyom. vela al (69 1) befalterin vela chame appe shechinta. begin divhay istallak shechinta mealma.

Menalan miyyaakov. dechad istallak shechinta minneh chashiv devivnohi hava pisul divginayyhu ittakkaf bealma rucha mesoova vegara nehora min sihara ufagim lah. vei tema ammay. begin deda saiv makdesha veistalleka shechinta mealoy deyaakov. kol shekken hahu dimsaav archeh vesaiv garmeh dehu atkif leh lerucha mesoova. uvegin kach kad istaav ikre ra.

Ta chaze, kad bar nash istaav la yitpakkad meim kudesha berich hu letav. uvechol zimna itpakkid mehahu deitkere ra levish. hada hu dichtiv, (Mishlei 19:23) vesavea yalin bal yippaked ra, kad azil beorach meshar, keden bal yippaked ra. veal da ketiv rak ra kol hayyom. uchetiv lo yegurecha ra. veda ikre ra vela ikre rasha. uchetiv (Tehillim 23:4) gam ki elech bege tzalmavet la ira ra ki atta immadi:

Vayyinachem Adonai ki asa et haadam baaretz vayyitatztzev el libbo. rabbi yose patach (Yeshayahu Adonai:18) hoy moshche heavon bechavle hashshav vechaavot haagala chattaa. hoy moshche heavon illen beni nasha dechatan kame marehon bechol yoma, veitdamman beenayyhu innun chovin deinnun kechavle hashsheva. vechashvin dehahu ovada deavdin vehahu chova deavdin delav ihu chelum vela ashgach behu kudesha berich hu. ad deavdin lehahu chova takkif verave kaavot haagala deihu takkif dela yachil leishtetzaa.

Veta chaze kad avid kudesha berich hu dina bechayyayve alma, af al gav deinnun chatan kamme kudesha berich hu veargezin leh kol yoma. la bae leovada lehu mealma. vechad ashgach beovadehon itnecham alayyhu al deinnun ovde yedoy veorich lon bealma.

Uvegin deinnun ovade yedoy natil nechama veitnecham alayyhu vechayis alayyhu. vechad bae lemebad behu dina kivyachol atziv (davar acher 33 chedvavn lo teol kodamohi) dechevan deovade yedoy innun, atziv alayyhu. kema deat amer, (Daniel 6:19) vedachavavn la haneel kadamohi.

Ketiv, (sefer acher veha ketiv) (Tehillim 96:6) hod vehadar lefanav oz vechedva bimkomo. amar rabbi yose ta chaze, vayyitatztzev el libbo ketiv. el libbo atziv vela leatar ochora. libbo kema deat amer, (Shmuel 1 2:35) kaasher bilvavi uvenafshi yaase. rabbi yitzchak amar vayyinnachem Adonai kema deat amer (Shemot 32:14) vayinnachem Adonai al haraa asher dibber laasot leammo.

Rabbi yesa amar letav. rabbi chizkiyya amar levish. rabbi yesa amar letav, kema deittemar dekudesha berich hu nachim al deinnun ovade yedoy vechayis alayyhu. vayyitatztzev begin deinnun chatan kammeh.

Verabbi chizkiyya amar levish dechad kudesha berich hu bae leovada lechayyayve alma natil nichumin alayyhu vekabbil nichumin. kivyachol keman dimkabbel nichumin al ma deavid. kevan dekabbel nichumin vadday dina itavad vela talya milleta bitshuva.

Ematay talya bitshuva, ad la kabbil tanchumin alayyhu. ha kabbil tanchumin alayyhu la talyay milleta bitshuva kelal vedina itavid. ucheden osif dina al dina, veatkif (lekamman 70 2) lehahu atar dedina, lemebad dina veovid lon lechayyayvaya min alma. vecholla bakkera dichtiv vayyinnachem Adonai. kibbel tanchumin. ulevatar vayyitatztzev el libbo. yahav tukepa ledina lemebad dina.

Rabbi chiyyay amar vayyinnachem Adonai ki asa et haadam baaretz. natal tanchumin vechedva, kad avad kudesha berich hu laadam beara deihu kegavvna illaa vechol malache illae meshabbechan leh lekudesha berich hu kad chamu leh bediukena illaa veamaru
113: (Tehillim 8:6) vattechasserehu meat meelohim vechavod vehadar teatterehu.
Levatar kad chata adam itatztzev kudesha berich hu al dechata. deyahav pitchon pe lemalache hashsharet deamru kammeh bekadmita kad baa lemivre leh, ma enosh ki tizkerennu uven adam ki tifkedennu.

Amar rabbi yehuda vayyitatztzev el libbo begin devae lemebad behu dina shenneemar (divrei hayamim 2 2) betzet lifne hechalutz veomrim hodu laAdonai ki leolam chasdo. veamar rabbi yitzchak ammay la ketiv hacha ki tov. ella begin deovid ovde yedoy kammayyhu deyisrael.

Kegavvna da kad havu yisrael avrin yamma. atu malache illae lememar shira kammeh kudesha berich hu behahu lelya. amar leh kudesha berich hu uma ovade yaday tavin beyamma veattun amrin shira. keden (Shemot 14:20) velo karav ze el ze kol hallayla. uf hacha bechol zimnin deibbud rashshiaya ihu mealma keden atzivu ishtechach alayyhu.

Rabbi abba amar beshaata dechav kamme kudesha berich hu adam veavar al pikkudoy, keden ishtechach atzivu kammeh. amar leh kudesha berich hu adam vavy dechalshat chela illaa. behay shaata itchashchat nehora chad. miyyad tarich leh migginta deeden.

Amar leh ana aalit lach leginta deeden lekarva karbana. veat pegimat madbecha dela itkerav karbana. mikkan ulehala laavod et haadama. vegazar aleh mita. vechas aleh kudesha berich hu veganiz leh beshaata demit samich leginta.

Ma avad adam avad mearta chada veittammar bah hu veitteteh. mena yada. ella chama chad nehora dakkik ayil behahu atar denafik migginta deeden vetaav teuveteh lekivreh. vetamman hu atar samuch litra deginta deeden.

Ta chaze, la istallak bar nash mealma ad dechame leh leadam harishon. shail leh al ma azil mealma vehech nafik. hu amar leh vavy divginach nefakna mealma. vehu ativ leh beri ana avarit al pikkuda chada veitannashit beginah. chame at kamma chovin vechamma pikkudin demarach avart.

Amar rabbi chiyyay ad kedo yoma kaim adam harishon vechaze baavahan teren zimnin beyoma veode al chovoy. veachme lon hahu atar dehava beh bikara illaa. veazil vechame kol innun tzaddikayyay vechaside denafku minnih veyartu lehahu yekara illaa divginta deeden. veavahan kulhon odan veamrin (Tehillim 36:8) ma yakar chasdecha elohim uvene adam betzel kenafecha yechosayun.

Rabbi yesa amar kulhu bene alma chaman leh leadam harishon beshaata demistalleke min alma, leachazaa sahaduta divgin chovoy devar nash ihu istallak mealma vela vegineh deadam. kema ditninan en mita belo chet.

Bar innun telata deistallaku begin hahu eta denachash hakkadmoni. veillen innun, amram levi uvinyamin. veit deamre uf name yishshay. dela chavu vela ishtechach alayyhu chova dimutun beh, bar deadkar alayyhu hahu eta denachash kidamaran.

Ta chaze, kulhon darin dehavu beyomoy denoach kulhu afshitu chovin al alma beitgalya leenehon decholla. rabbi shimon hava azil yoma chad befile ditverya, chama beni nesha dehave mekatre bekitra dekashta bekulefa dekansir. amar uma chova da beitgalya leargaza lemarehon. yahiv enoy behu veitremiyyu lego yamma umitu.

Ta chaze, kol chova deitavid beitgalya dache lah lishchinta meara uselikat diyyurah mealma. illen havu azlin berisha zakif veavde chovayyhu beitgalyay vedachu lah lishchinta mealma. ad dekudesha berich hu dacha lon veaavir lon minneh. veal da ketiv (Mishlei 25:5) hago rasha lifni melech vegomer hago siggim mikkesef vegomer:
Vayyomer Adonai lo yadon ruchi baadam leolam beshaggam hu basar vegomer. amar rabbi elazar ta chaze, kad bera kudesha berich hu alma avad lehay alma leishtammasha
114: Kegavvna dilela. vechad bene alma innun zakkain deazle beorach meshar, kudesha berich hu atar rucha dechayye dilela ad dematu innun chayyin leatar deyaakov sharya beh.

Umittamman nagde innun chayyin ad deitmeshich hahu rucha lehay olam dedavid malka sharya beh. umittamman nagde birchan lechulhu innun tattae. vehahu rucha illaa itnegid veitmeshich letatta veyachlin leitkayyma bealma.

Uvegine kach leolam chasdo da hu olam dedavid malka. uvegin kach ketiv leolam bela vav. deha kad (ihu) hahu rucha itnegid lehahu olam, mittamman nafke birchan vechayyin lechola leitkayyma. hasheta dechavu bene nasha istallak kolla. begin dela yimte hahu rucha dechayye lehay olam leithannaa minneh tattae uleitkayyma beh. beshaggam hu basar begin dela yitrak hay rucha lehay olam. may tama dela leasgaa nachash tattaa. dedargin deyittakkaf beh (davar acher 33 uvaenan) rucha dikdusha dela yitarav beruach mesaav.

Beshaggam hu basar da nachash kadmaa deyitbarach vegin kach hu basar kema deat amer, (Bereshit 6:13) ketz kol basar ba lefanay veamar rabbi shimon da malach hammavet. vehayu yamav mea veesrim shana orichu dekusetira dekitra:

Hannefilim hayu baaretz. tane rabbi yose illen azza vaazael. kema deittemar deappik (davar acher deappil) lon kudesha berich hu mikdushata dilela. vei tema vehech yachlu leitkayyma behay alma. amar rabbi chiyyay illen havu meinnun dichtiv veof yeofef al haaretz. veha ittemar deillen itchazu livne nasha kechezu dilhon. vei tema hech yachlin leithappacha. ha ittemar deithappechan lechamma gevavnin uveshaata denachte aglimu baavira dealma veitchazzun kivne nasha.

Vehane azza vaazael demardu leela veappil lon kudesha berich hu veaglimu beara veitkayymu beh vela yachilu leitpashta minneh. ulevatar tau batar neshe alma. vead kean yoma da innun kayyme veolfe charshin livne nasha veolidu benin vekaru lehu anakim gibbarin. veinnun nefilim ikrun bene elohim. veha ittemar.

Vayyomer Adonai emche et haadam asher barati meal peni haadama. rabbi yose patach (Yeshayahu 55:8) ki lo machshevotay machshevotechem. ta chaze, kad bar nash bae lenakma meachara shatik vela amar midi. deilu odeh yistammar vela yachil leh.

Aval kudesha berich hu lav hachi avid. la avid dina bealma ad deachriz veoda lehu zimna teren utelata. begin dela itay deyimche bideh deyema leh ma avadat vela yistammar minneh vela yachil lekayyma kammeh.
Ta chaze, vayyomer Adonai emche et haadam asher barati meal pene haadama. oda lon al yeda denoach veatre behon kamma zimnin vela shame. batar dela shemau, ayyte alehon dina veovid lon meal appe ara.

Ta chaze ma ketiv beh benoach vayyikra et shemo (60 1) noach lemor ze yenachamenu mimmaasenu. (ze mekomo baddaf 60 474 bahegahet 216) (sefer acher amay hacha lemor. veammay ze. ella lemor da itteta. ze da tzaddik. ramaz dekudesha berich hu kera leh lenoach nayycha deara. lemor. may lemor. ella atar da kare leh 58 uman ihu ara kaddisha. lemor ze yenachamenu eved leh kudesha berich hu letatta kegavvna ilaa. ketiv hacha ze yenachamenu uchetiv hatam 2 ze Adonai kivvinu lo. zakkain innun tzaddikayyay dirshimin birshimu degushepanka demalka ilaa lemeheve bishmeh reshimin. veihu shavvi shemahan beara kedka yeot. ketiv Vayikra et shemo noach, uchetiv, 3 Vayikra 346 yaakov. amay lo ketiv et. ella hatam darga 4 vehacha darga achara. kema deat amar 5 vaere et Adonai. vaere Adonai lo ketiv ella et Adonai. uf hacha Vayikra 346 yaakov darga dileh kudesha berich hu mammash kare leh yaakov. aval hacha 401, leachlela shechinta). mena hava yada. ella beshaata delayyt kudesha berich hu alma dichtiv arura haadama baavurecha. amar adam kamme
115: Kudesha berich hu, ribbono shel olam ad matay yehe alma belatyuta. amar leh ad deyityelid lach ben mahul kegavvna dilach.
Vehavu mechakkan ad shaata deityallid noach. vechevan deityaylid (58 59 2) chama leh gazir rashim beat kaddisha. vechama shechinta mitdabbeka bahadeh. keden kara shemeh al ma deavid levatar.

Bekadmita la havu yade lemizra ulemechetzad ulemecherash vehavu avde pulechana deara bidayyhu. kevan deata noach atkin umenuta lehu vechol manin (96 2) ditzrichin letakna ara lemebad perin. hada hu dichtiv ze yenachamenu mimmaasenu umeitzvon yadenu, min haadama. deihu appik ara mimma deitlatyay. dehavu zarin chittin vekatzrin govin vedardarin. uvegine chach ketiv ish haadama.

Rabbi yehuda amar ish haadama kema deat amer, (Rut 1:3) ish noomi. begin deikre tzaddik veappik lah leara bekarbana deavad mimma deitlatyay dichtiv lo osif lekallel od et haadama baavur haadam. uvegin da ikre ish haadama. veal da kera leh shema al ma deyete.

Rabbi yehuda patach (Tehillim 46:9) lechu chazu mifalot elohim asher sam shammot baaretz. hay kera ukemuha veittemar. aval lechu chazu vegomer. (may chazu kema deat amar, 1 chazut kashe havegad li. beovadoy dekudesha berich hu itgeli nevua illaa livne nasha. asher sham Shemot beeretz. Shemot vadday deha shemma garim lecholla) (vehu leshon shemmamon) deillu havu mifalot yod ha vav ha sam kiyyum baaretz, aval begin dehavu mifalot shema delohim sam shammot baaretz.

Amar leh rabbi chiyyay hasheta itarat lehay. lav, ana hachi amina leh. begin deven shema da uven shema da kolla hu shevacha. aval ana amina leh kema deitaru chavraya deshave shemahan. shammot baaretz shemot mammash (sham beeretz veammay begin leishtammesha behu alma ulemeheve kiyyuma bealma).

Rabbi yitzchak amar kolla hu. veafillu ma deamar rabbi yehuda shappir kaamar. deillu yehe alma bishma derachame yitkayyaym alma, aval begin deitbere alma al dina vekayyma al dina sam shammot baaretz veshappir hu deilmale kach la yachil alma leitkayyma mikkamme chovehon divne nasha.

Ta chaze, noach kad ityeylid karun leh al shema dinchama (58, nayychealeyh, nayycha lealma, nayycha laavahan, nayycha levinyan, nayycha laalaayn, nayycha latetaayn, nayycha lealma din, nayycha lealma deate) veleheve (davar acher ulemeheve) shema garim. aval (nusach acher legabbe) kudesha berich hu lav hachi. noach behippuch atvavn chen kema deat amer venoach matza chen. amar rabbi yose chen hayeynu noach. betzaddikayay shemehon garim letav. bechayyayvaya shemehon garim levish. benoach ketiv venoach matza chen beene Adonai. beer bechor yehuda ithappachu atvoy levish. er ra. ra beene Adonai.

Ta chaze, kevan deityeylid noach chama ovadehon divne nasha deinnun chatan kamme kudesha berich hu, vehava ganiz garmeh veishtedal befulechana demareh. begin delo lemehach beorchayyhu. vechi tomar bamma ishtaddal. behahu (37 2) sifra deadam vesifra dechanoch vehava ishtaddal behu lemiflach lemareh.

Ta chaze, dehachi hu deha noach mena hava yada likrav karbana lemareh. ella begin deashkach chachmeta al ma mitkayyem alma veyada deal karbana mitkayyem. veilmale karbana la havu kayyme illae vetattae.
Rabbi shimon hava azil bearcha vehavu immeh rabbi elazar bereh verabbi yose verabbi chiyyay. ad dehavu azle, amar rabbi elazar leavuhi archa metakna kamman bainan lemishma mille deorayyta.

Patach rabbi shimon veamar (Kohelet 10:3) gam badderech keshehassachol holech libbo chaser vegomer. kad bar nash bae leatkana archeh kamme kudesha berich hu. ad la yippuk learcha bae leamlacha beh uletzalle kammeh al archeh. kema detaninan dichtiv, (Tehillim 85:14) tzedek lefanav yehallech veyasem lederech peamav. deha shechinta la itparsha minneh.
Uman deihu la mehemna bemareh, ma ketiv
116: Beh vegam badderech keshehassachol holech libbo chaser. man libbo. da kudesha berich hu dela yehach immeh bearcha vegara min siyyayteh bearcheh. begin dehahu bar nash dela meheman beh bemareh ad la yippuk bearcha la bae siyyata demareh.

Veafillu bearcha kad ihu azil la ishtaddal bemille deorayyta. uvegine chach libbo chaser dela azil bahadeh demareh vela ishtechach bearcheh. veomer lakkol sachol hu, afillu kad shema milla dimhemnuta demareh, hu amar detippeshuta hu leishtaddala beh.

Kehay deshailu levar nash (chad) al at keyayma dirshimu bevisreh devar nash. veamar lav ihu mehemnuta. shama rav yeva sava veistakkal beh veitavid tilla degarme. veanan behay orcha besiyyayta dekudesha berich hu bainan lememar mille deorayyta.

Patach veamar (Tehillim 86:11) horeni Adonai darkecha ahallech baamittecha yached levavi leyira shemecha. hay kera kashya. deha taninan kola hi bida dekudesha berich hu, bar lemeheve zakkaa o chayyayva. vedavid hech tava da meim kudesha berich hu.

Ella david hachi kaamar. horeni Adonai darkecha. hahu orach mishor umetakna legallaa enay uleminda leh, ulevatar ahallech baamittecha ehach beorach keshot vela aste leyamina velismala. yached levavi man levavi. kema deat amer (Tehillim 73:26) tzur levavi vechelki. vechol da ana tava leyira et shemecha. leitdabbeka bedachaltach, leistammara orche kedka yaot. leyira shemecha atar chuleki deveh sharya dachalta lemidchal.

Ta chaze, kol bar nash dedachil leh lekudesha berich hu sharya immeh mehemnuta kedka yeut deha hahu bar nash shelim befulechana demareh. uman dela sharya beh dachala demareh la sharyay immeh mehemnuta velav ihu keday lemeheve leh chulaka bealma deate.

Tu patach veamar, (Mishlei 4:18) veorach tzaddikim keor noga holech veor ad nechon hayyom. zakkain innun tzaddikaya bealma den uvealma deate dekudesha berich hu bae bikarehon. ta chaze, ma ketiv veorach tzaddikim keor noga. may keor noga. kehahu nehora denahir devara kudesha berich hu beovada divreshit, da hu deganiz lon letzaddikaya lealma deate. holech veor deihu salik binhoreh tadir vela gara minneh.

Aval bechayyayvaya ma ketiv, (Mishlei 4:19) derech reshaim kaafela, lo yadu bamme yikkashelu. lo yadu, vechi la yadin. ella chayyayvaya azle beakimu dearcha behay alma. vela baan leistakkela dezammin (davar acher 33 lon) kudesha berich hu lemedan lehu behahu alma uleaalaa lon bedina degehinnom. veinnun tzavvchin veamrin vavy lan dela orichna udenin vela atzitna behahu alma. uvechol yoma amre vavy da (237 2).

Ta chaze, zammin kudesha berich hu leanhara lon letzaddikayya lealma deate, ulemehav lon agar chulakhon atar deena la shalta lemekam aleh kema deat amer, (Yeshayahu 64:3) ayin lo raata elohim zulatecha yaase limchakke lo. uchetiv, (Yeshayahu 66:24) veyatzu verau befigre haanashim happoshim bi. uchetiv, (Malachi 3:21) veassotem reshaim ki yihyu efer tachat kappot raglechem. zakkain innun tzaddikaya bealma den uvealma deate. alayyhu ketiv (Yeshayahu 60:21) tzaddikim leolam yirshu aretz. uchetiv, (Tehillim 140:14) ach tzaddikim yodu lishmecha yeshvu yesharim et panecha. baruch Adonai leolam amen veamen (chaser):
117: Elle toldot noach, rabbi chiyyay patach (Yeshayahu 60:21) veammech kullam tzaddikim leolam yirshu aretz netzer mattaay maase yaday lehitpaer. zakkain innun yisrael demishtaddele beorayyta, veyade archin deorayyta, divginah yizkun lealma deate.

Ta chaze, kol yisrael it lon chulaka lealma deate. may tama begin denatrin berit dealma itkayyem aleh. kema deat amer, (Yirmeyahu 33:25) im lo veriti yomam valayla chukkot shamayim vaaretz lo samti. veal da yisrael denatre berit vekabbilu leh it lon chulaka bealma deate.

Velo od ella begin chach ikrun tzaddikim. mikkan olifna kol man denatir hay berit dealma itkeyyaym aleh. ikre tzaddik. mena lan miyyosef. begin denatar leh livrit alma, zacha deikre tzaddik. veal kach veammech kullam tzaddikim leolam yirshu aretz.

Rabbi elazar amar, elle bechol atar pasal et harishonim taninan vechulei. ma ketiv leela befarshata divreshit (Bereshit 2:10) venahar yotze meeden lehashekot et haggan umishsham yippared vegomer. hahu nahar denagid venafik veayyil leginta veashke leh mishshakyu dilela veavid leh nayycha veavid ibbin verabbe zarin. vehu keden nayycha lechola. veda nayycha leh leginta. veda avid nayycha beh (nusach acher leginta. veginta nayycha beh). kema deat amer (Bereshit 3) ki vo shavat. uchetiv, (Bereshit 2:2) vayyishbot bayyom hashshevii. veda raza demilla da avid toldot vela ochora.

Ta chaze (28 2 kegavvna da noach letatta. kayyeyma kaddisha hava dugema dilella. veal da ikre ayshaheademah. veraza olifna, deha noach itzterich latteva leitchabbera bah. ulekayyeyma zara dechola dichtiv lichyot zera.)

Man teva. da (da) (33 2) aron habberit. venoach veteva letatta hachi havu kedugema (da) dilela. noach ketiv beh berit dichtiv vahakimoti et beriti ittach vegomer. vead deitkeyyaym beh berit la ayil letevuta. dichtiv vahakimoti et beriti ittach uvata el hatteva. ucheden hava teva aron habberit.
Teva venoach kolla kegavvna dilela. uvegin dehay berit leela hu avid toldot. kegavvna da noach (davar acher letatta) ihu avid toldot. begine kach (kema deat amar) elle toldot noach.

Noach ish tzaddik. hachi hu vadday kegavvna dilela. veal da (Mishlei 10:25) vetzaddik yesod olam ketiv. veara al da itkayymat. deha ihu ammuda dealma kayyma aleh. uman ihu da tzaddik. venoach ikre tzaddik letatta.

Veraza (nusach acher da) dechola, et haelohim hithallech noach, dayyka, dela itperash minneh lealmin. ulemeheve hu beara kegavvna dilela ish tzaddik yesoda dealma. berit shalom shelama dealma. ish haadama vadday. veal da (Bereshit 6:8) venoach matza chen beene Adonai.

Tamim haya bedorotav. may bedorotav, ilen innun denafku minneh. hu ashlim lechulhu. vehu hava shelim mikkulhu. tamim haya deityeylid mahul dichtiv hithallech lefanay vehye tamim. bedorotav velo bedarin dealma deha minneh nafku (toldot bealma).

Ta chaze, noach itchazze miyyoma deitberi alma lemeheve beteva bechibbura chad ulemeal bah, vead la itchabberu kechada la hava alma kedka yeut, levatar ma ketiv, (Bereshit 9:19) umeelle naftza kol haaretz. mahu naftza. kema deat amer, (Bereshit 2:10) umishsham yippared. demittamman ishtechach piruda veitbaddaru toldot lechol sitrin
Vecholla chad kedugema chada. begine chach elle toldot noach. elle vadday. deha yesoda dealma ihu deavid
118: Toldot lekayyma beara. ata rabbi abba uneshakeh. amar arya becheleh tinara nakiv vetavar. kach hu vadday. veta chaze, mishshiura detevuta uf name hachi hu.

Tosefta lamma noach noach tere zimni. ella kol tzaddik vtztzaddik di bealma itt leh teren ruchin. rucha chad bealma den vrucha chad bealma deatte. vhachi tishkach bechulhu tzaddike moshe moshe, yaakov yaakov, avraham avraham, shemuel shemuel, shem shem. bar miyyitztzechak dela ketiv beh kema dichtiv behu. begin deyitztzechak beshaatta deittekrav al gabbe madbecha nappekatt nishmatteh dehavatt beh behay alma. vchevan deittemar beh beavraham, barucha mechayye hammettim tavatt beh nishmatteh dealma deatte. begin da tishkach dela yiched kudesha bericha hu shemeh ella al yitztzechak begin deittechashav kemett veal da ramaz kera vamar (Iyov 7) hen bikdoshav lo yaamin vegomer.

Davar acher elle toldott begin dehava tzaddik shabbach leh tere zimni. tamim haya bedorottav, aval bedarin acharanin eno nechshav lichlum, kemo dara deavraham vdara demoshe vdara dedavid. davar acher chame may avad bedara dechulhu chayyayvim, kal vachomer illu haya bedara dechulhu tzaddikim: (74 kan tosefta)

Rabbi elazar patach (Tehillim 46:9) lechu chazu mifalot (bidfus kareymevanea elokim, 86 340 leel noach 2) Adonai asher sam shammot baaretz. hay kera ha ittemar veukemuha. aval lechu chazu, may chazu. kema deat amer, (Yeshayahu 21:2) chazut kashe hugad li. beovadoy dekudesha berich hu avid, itgeli nevua illaa livni nasha. asher sam shammot, shemot vadday, deha shema garim lecholla.

Ketiv vayyikra et shemo noach lemor ze vegomer ammay hacha lemor. veammay ze. ella (huva leel daf noach 1 leshon ze) lemor da itteta. ze da tzaddik. (247 kemo dekudesha berich hu kera leh 58 nayycha deara. lemor, may lemor. ella atar da kare leh 58. uman ihu ara kaddisha. lemor ze yenachamenu mimmaasenu vegomer. eved leh kudesha berich hu letatta kegavvna illaa) (nusach acher ze da tzaddik vechen noach 2 da tzaddik. lemor da nukeba. begin dela mitparshan da min da. amar rabbi yitzchak lemor da ara kaddisha) (veze emet) (140 beemet bahegahet davar acher. 507) ketiv hacha ze yenachamenu, uchetiv hatam (Yeshayahu 25:9) ze Adonai kivvinu lo. zakkain innun tzaddikaya dirshimin birshimu degushepanka demalka lemehve bishmeh reshimin veihu shave shemahan beara kedka yeut.

Ketiv vayyikra et shemo noach. uchetiv, (vayyeshev kafu 2) vayyikra shemo yaakov. ammay la ketiv et. ella hatam darga achara (davar acher chada) vehacha darga ochara. (nusach acher et, kema deat amar vaere et Adonai) kedichtiv, (yeshaya 6) vaere et Adonai. vaere Adonai la ketiv ella et Adonai. uf hacha benoach vayyikra et shemo noach. vayyikra shemo yaakov darga dileh, kudesha berich hu mammash kara leh yaakov. aval hacha et leitkelala shechinta. (nusach acher dehi darga achara letatta):

Elle toldot noach vegomer. rabbi yehuda patach (Tehillim 112:5) tov ish chonen umalve yechalkel devarav bemishpat. tov ish, da kudesha berich hu deikre tov. kema dichtiv, (Tehillim 145:9) tov Adonai lakkol. uchetiv, (Shemot 15:3) Adonai ish milchama. lehay kol chonen umalve. leatar delet leh middileh. vehahu atar minneh ittezan yechalkel devarav bemishpat, deha hahu davar la ittezan ella bemishpat kema deat amer (Tehillim 89:15) tzedek umishpat mechon kisecha.

Davar acher tov ish, da tzaddik dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 3:10) imru tzaddik ki tov ki peri maallehem yochelu. rabbi yose amar da noach dichtiv noach ish tzaddik. rabbi yitzchak amar da shevacha deshabbat, deveh patach tov, dichtiv, (Tehillim 92:2) tov lehodot laAdonai.
Rabbi chiyyay amar kolla chad vechulhu milla chada amru. veda avid toldot bealma. toldot dealma man innun. illen nishmathon detzaddikaya deinnun ibba deovadoy dekudesha berich hu.

Rabbi shimon amar beshaata dekudesha berich hu mitatter beitroy, mitatter meela umittatta. meela meatar deamika decholla. mitatter mittatta bamme. benishmathon detzaddikaya. keden ittosaf chayyim meela umittatta. veitkelil atar makdesha mikkol sitrin uvera itmalyay veyamma ishtelim, ucheden yahav lecholla.

Ketiv, (Mishlei Adonai:15) shete mayim mibborcha venozlim mittoch beercha. ammay (hacha) borcha bekadmita ulevatar beercha. deha bor la ikre ella rekanya dela nevia. beer mayin denavin. ella kola atar chad hu. ella atar demiskene (nusach acher damesakenavetaa) achidan beh ikre bor. delet leh middileh ella ma deyahavin begavveh. uman ihu 444.
Levatar itavid beer deihu nevia umalya (davar acher demalya) mikkol sitrin. uman ihu hei. itmalyay meela
119: Unevia mittatta. itmalyay meela kema deamaran. unevia mittatta minnishmathon detzaddikaya.

Davar acher shete mayim mibborcha, da david malka dichtiv beh (Shmuel 2 23:15) mi yashkeni mayim mibbor bet lechem. it man deyemar, venozlim da yitzchak. mittoch da moshe deihu beemtzaita. beercha da aharon deitkere beer mayim chayyim. vedavid malka deitchabbar imhon. venozlim da avraham. mittoch, da yaakov deihu beemtzaita. beercha da yitzchak deikre beer mayim chayyim. ha behay kera ishtechach reticha kaddisha illaa meavahan. vedavid malka itchabbar imhon.

Tiuveta denukeva legabbe dechura lav ihu ella kad ayyil rucha vah veashdat mayyay lekivla mayyin illain dechurin. kach keneset yisrael la itarat tiuveta legabbe kudesha berich hu, ella berucha detzaddikaya dealin begavvav. ucheden navin mayyay miggavvav lekivla mayyin didchura. vecholla itavid tiuveta chada (sefer acher vetzibbura chada) utzerora chada vekishshura chada. veda hu raava decholla vetiyyula dimtayyel kudesha berich hu benishmathon detzaddikayay.

Ta chaze, kol innun toldot deginta deeden la nafkin mitztzaddik. ella kad ayyil behay teva bechibbura chada. vecholla genizin bah. ulevatar minah nafkin. uf hacha noach ish tzaddik la appik toldot lemifre bealma ad deal latteva veitkenash kolla bah vehavu genizin bah. ulevatar minnah nafku lemifre bealma uleitkayyma beara. veilmale denafku miggo teva la itkayyeymu bealma.

Vecholla kegavvna dilela. miggo teva nafke leela. miggo teva nafke letatta. da kegavvna da. (miggo) vehacha itkeyyaym alma vela mikkadmat dena. divgine chach ketiv venozlim mittoch beercha. uchetiv vayyoled noach shelosha vanim (amar rabbi yehuda vegomer kakkatuv baddaf sav 1):

Vattishshachet haaretz lifne haelohim. amar rabbi yehuda kevan dichtiv vattishshachet haaretz ammay lifni haelohim. ella kevan deavadu chovehon beitgalleya leenehon decholla keden lifne haelohim ketiv.

Rabbi yose amar ana ifcha amarit. vattishshachet haaretz lifni haelohim. bekadmita lifne haelohim dela havu avde beitgalleyay. lifne haelohim avadu vela lifne bene nesha. ulevasof avadu beitgalleya hada hu dichtiv vattimmale haaretz chamas. dela hava atar bechol ara dela hava beitgalleya. uvegin kach bitre gavvne amar kera.

Elle toldot noach. rabbi abba amar miyyoma deavar adam al pekuda demareh kol bene alma deityallidu levatar ikrun bene haadam. vela lishvacha ikrun hachi. ella keman deamar benoy dehahu deavar al pekuda demareh.
Kevan deata noach, ikrun bene alma al shemeh denoach. toldot noach leshivcha. dekaim lon bealma. vela toldot deadam deaavur lon mealma vegarim mota lechulhu.

Amar leh rabbi yose, i hachi, ha ketiv levatar vayyered Adonai lirot et hair veet hammigdal asher banu beni haadam. bene haadam ketiv vela ketiv bene noach. amar leh begin deadam (dechata davar acher chet) kamme mareh tav leh dela ivre vela yichtov aleh hay kera.

Ella ta chaze, ketiv (Mishlei 10:1) ben chacham yesammach av. kad bera tav, kol beni alma dachrin leh leavoy letav. vechad ihu bish, kolla dachrin leh leavoy levish. adam begin dechata veavar al pekuda demareh, kad atu innun demardu bemarehon ma ketiv asher banu bene haadam benoy (75 1) deadam kadmaa demarad bemareh veavar al pekudeh.
Uvegine chach elle toldot noach. elle vela kadmae. elle denafku vealu go teva veappiku toldin lealmin vela toldot adam denafak migginta deeden vela appik lon mittamman.

Ta chaze, illu appik adam toldot migginta deeden, la yishtetzun ledare darin. vela itchashshach nehora desihara lealmin. vechulhu havu kayymin lealmin. veafillu malache illai la kayyme kamayyhu binhora veziva vechachmeta. kema deat amer betzelem elohim bara oto. aval kevan degarim
